plugins.readme_text:
# 我的 DSH 插件清单

此文档列举我个人在 DeepSeek Harness 上使用/维护的 out-of-tree 插件。

| 插件 | 为什么需要它 | profile 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-local-policy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-local-policy) | 它以纯 patch 捆绑（无代码）施加本地部署策略：把框架默认的 web 搜索提供方从 DeepSeek 切换为通用 HTTP 提供方，并禁用 DeepSeek 官方集成与 OTel 会话上报。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（patch 引用的 entry id 在该独立树中不存在） |
| [`dsh-logger-channels`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-logger-channels) | 它给操作者提供框架与全部插件 `ctx.logger` 输出的可见出口：向 cordis 注册命名通道（stderr/stdout/file，file 通道纯大小轮转），因为宿主只自带内存环形缓冲，没有它日志只进内存。 | ✅ web；其余长驻 profile 原理上可兼容——未验证 |
| [`@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin`](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking) | 它给 agent 提供由 OpenViking 支撑的长期记忆：跨会话读写记忆，并在共享同一 OpenViking 的 profile 之间传递上下文。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal（MCP client 可用性未验证） |
| [`dsh-timer`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-timer) | 它给 profile 提供进程内定时任务，语义对齐 systemd.timer，每次运行创建一个新 agent 会话执行任务 prompt。 | ✅ web；⚠️ headless（30s tick 调度器在一次性进程中无意义）；✅ sdk/acp（长驻进程）；❌ sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-email`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-email) | 它让 agent 能读写邮件：对 IMAP/SMTP 账号提供列目录、搜索、读取、标记、保存附件与发送/回复/转发，并支持新邮件事件触发，使 agent 能实时响应来信。 | ✅ 全部 profile（软读取、优雅降级）；⚠️ headless（IDLE 触发在一次性进程中无意义） |
| [`dsh-ntfy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-ntfy) | 它给 agent 提供推送通知出口：一次工具调用即把消息发布到 ntfy topic，使作业结果、告警与报告能送达操作者设备或任意订阅该 topic 的应用。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-webhook-dispatcher`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-webhook-dispatcher) | 它给 profile 提供入站 webhook 入口：端点路由挂在框架主 web server 上，外部投递经 method 门控、token 鉴权、请求体大小限制与每端点队列/并发约束后，派发为受控 trigger 会话，使外部系统能触发 agent。 | ✅ web；其余 profile 需组合 `dsh-host-webserver` |
| [`dsh-surfing-plugin`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-surfing-plugin) (forked) | 它为 agent 的联网能力提供后端：允许其接入基于 SearXNG 的搜索与基于 Crawl4AI 的页面抓取。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（无 base web_search） |
| [`dsh-tts`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-tts) | 它让 agent 能合成语音：允许其接入任意 OpenAI 兼容 TTS 后端。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-imagegen`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-imagegen) | 它让 agent 能生成图像：单个 `imagegen` 工具接入任意 OpenAI 兼容图像后端并渲染图像，并可检查已配置后端及其实时状态。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot) (forked) | 它给 profile 提供 QQ IM 通道：维持与 QQ 开放平台的 WS 长连接，处理 QQ 消息的收发与 bot 生命周期，使 agent 能经 QQ 与用户实时交互。 |  ✅ web；❌ headless（一次性进程 + 交互式 QR 绑定）；✅ sdk/acp/sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-qqbot-send`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot-send) | 它让 agent 能主动把文本、Markdown 或文件附件发送到任意 QQ 目标（私聊/群/频道/公会 DM）；独立调用 QQ 开放平台 REST API，因此可以在没有 qqbot 网关的 profile 中单独挂载。 |  ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal |

图例：✅ 兼容 / ⚠️ 可组成功能降级 / ❌ 不兼容 / ❓ 未验证。(forked) = 个人分叉版本。

---

注：除非另有说明，以上插件的自维护版本均使用 QWen3.8-27B groupwise-int 在 DeepSeek Harness 上通过 “Vibe Coding” 产出。软件按“原样”提供，不提供任何形式的明示或暗示的担保。

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏余额栏：自动显示官方账号余额，点击在 DSH 内查询用量
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 侧栏余额栏

社区 desktop 插件 `dsh-balance-bar`（非 DeepSeek 官方出品），兼容 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。在原生 `sidebar.footer.action` 插槽添加常驻充值余额栏，位于现有账号入口上方。不替换账号入口、不修改核心、不注入定位 DOM、不启动额外服务。

## 行为

- 使用 Host `deepseekAccount.getBalance()`，复用当前登录，不读取或向前端传递凭证。
- Client 每 10 秒读取；Host 按需查询上游，最短间隔 30 秒，合并并发请求。隐藏页面暂停读取，回到窗口补检查（仍遵守缓存间隔）。不是服务端实时推送。点击余额栏使用原生按钮同款 `globalThis.dshPlatform.open('usage', bounds)` 桥接，在 DSH 内嵌官方用量页，不打开外部浏览器。插件提供返回按钮、视口尺寸同步与关闭清理；凭证仍由原生桥接管理。桌面桥接不可用或已退出账号时禁用入口。该桥接依赖当前桌面版本，升级时需要复验。
- 充值与赠送余额不相加；主栏显示充值余额，悬浮说明显示赠送余额和更新时间。空钱包显示 `—`，不会伪造零余额。
- Host 监听账号变化并清空缓存，以代际校验丢弃切换账号前的在途响应。前端最迟下一次成功读取时同步退出状态。网络失败清空前端金额，Host 上游失败保留旧金额并明确显示“过期”。
- 折叠侧栏隐藏余额栏；原账号入口保持可点击。所有请求、订阅、定时器、样式和注册跟随插件卸载清理。上游服务不接受取消参数，已开始请求只能在结束后丢弃结果。
- 本机路由 `/myspace-balance-bar/api` 限制 loopback、合法 Host、同源 Origin/Fetch Metadata 和自定义请求头；只支持本机浏览器，不提供 CORS。

## 开发与安装

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装 npm 包 `dsh-balance-bar`，无需配置 API Key，使用 DSH 当前登录的官方账号。仅支持 desktop profile；不要安装到 Web profile。

无需构建，原生 ModuleLoader Client 随包分发。开发时可安装 `link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-bar`。禁用 bundle 即移除余额栏。升级后建议重启 DSH，避免 Host 模块缓存仍执行旧代码。

旧版本地包 `myspace-dsh-balance-bar` 必须先禁用或卸载，再安装本包；不要同时启用两者（共用路由与插槽标识）。

源码与问题反馈：https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-balance-bar 。

```sh
npm test
node --check src/client.js
```

验证覆盖余额缓存、并发合并、失败状态、退出与切换账号、卸载丢弃在途响应及请求来源校验。已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 桌面验证余额栏与内嵌官方用量页；居中加载动画通过代码检查，尚未单独捕获实机加载阶段。实际账号退出使用隔离测试覆盖，不会在验收中退出用户登录。

## 限制

- 余额定时查询而非实时推送；官方用量页统计可能存在延迟。
- 原生内嵌页使用当前桌面版本桥接；不支持普通浏览器中的页面跳转。
- 加载中仅显示居中转圈，无说明文字；系统减少动态效果偏好下不旋转。
- 本插件不采集账户凭证、不上传余额、不提供充值操作。

## 可信发布

`.github/workflows/publish.yml` 使用 GitHub Actions OIDC 发布，无需保存 npm Token。触发方式为发布 GitHub Release，或手动指定已有的 `vX.Y.Z` 标签；标签必须匹配包版本。

npm 包设置中的 Trusted Publisher 必须配置：GitHub Actions、组织/用户 `fegnze`、仓库 `dsh-balance-bar`、工作流 `publish.yml`，Environment 留空。配置需要 npm 账号持有人完成二步验证；仅提交工作流不代表授权已经生效。

## License

MIT，见 LICENSE。

plugins.description: Every ArtCraft (storytold) crafting app as a DSH plugin — 12 Cordis plugins driving CADCraft, GridCraft, SoundCraft and 9 more headlessly, each over its own CLI and MCP server.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft × DSH **Twelve crafting applications. One agent. Zero source changes.** Every app from the [ArtCraft](https://github.com/storytold) org — CAD, spreadsheets, audio, video, photo, vector, PDF, slides, documents — exposed to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as a first-class plugin. [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![built on Cordis](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20on-Cordis-6E56CF?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20OR%20Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square)](#license) [![Plugins](https://img.shields.io/badge/plugins-12-success?style=flat-square)](#the-twelve) [![Tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-92-informational?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-bridged-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified-12%2F12-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](#verify-it-yourself) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
--- ```console $ dsh --profile web you › make me a Q3 sales spreadsheet with a chart, save it to ~/Documents ⏺ gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} 315 commands, 8 families ⏺ gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} {range?, type?, title?, at?} ⏺ gridcraft_run sample "sales", 2 commands exited 0 in 41ms ⏺ gridcraft_inspect ~/Documents/q3.xlsx 1 sheet, 1 chart, A1:H24 ✔ GridCraft wrote ~/Documents/q3.xlsx (14,208 bytes) ``` ## What this is The ArtCraft suite is twelve native Rust applications. Each one already ships a headless CLI and its own MCP server — but nothing tells an agent they exist, what they can do, or how to call them. This repository closes that gap. Each app becomes a **DSH plugin** that registers model-callable tools on `ctx.tools`, discovers the app's binary on your machine, and drives it as an external process. **No craft source is ever modified.** Every plugin lives here. The applications are dependencies, not forks. ## The twelve | | Craft | What it does | Commands | MCP tools | |:--|:--|:--|--:|--:| | 📐 | **CADCraft** | CAD and drafting (AutoCAD-style) | 305 | 11 | | 📊 | **GridCraft** | Spreadsheets (Excel-style) | 315 | 21 | | 🎚️ | **SoundCraft** | Digital audio workstation | 465 | 17 | | 🖼️ | **PhotoCraft** | Raster image editing (Photoshop-style) | 858 | 21 | | 🌄 | **LightCraft** | Photo library and raw development | 296 | 318 | | 📄 | **PdfCraft** | PDF reading and editing | 161 | 161 | | 🖋️ | **VectorCraft** | Vector art (Illustrator-style) | 743 | 32 | | 🎬 | **EffectCraft** | Motion graphics (After Effects-style) | 669 | 27 | | 🎞️ | **FilmCraft** | Non-linear video editing | 693 | 17 | | 🎨 | **DesignCraft** | Page and layout design (InDesign-style) | 446 | 25 | | 📽️ | **DeckCraft** | Presentations (PowerPoint-style) | 226 | 25 | | 📝 | **WordCraft** | Word processing (Word-style) | 460 | 16 | Command counts are read live from each binary; MCP counts are what each server declares. ## Two surfaces per craft Every plugin exposes **both**, because they answer different questions:
Generic commandsThe craft's own MCP server
Reaches the **entire application** — every menu item is a command id. ``` gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} gridcraft_run {"commands": [...], "save": "..."} gridcraft_inspect {"file": "..."} gridcraft_convert {"input": "...", "output": "..."} ``` **Modelled operations** with real JSON Schemas, served over JSON-RPC by the app itself. ``` gridcraft_mcp_tools {"search": "range"} gridcraft_mcp_call {"tool": "write_range", "arguments": {"range": "A1", "values": [["x"]]}} gridcraft_mcp_status {} ```
The MCP server is spawned once per plugin and kept warm — starting GridCraft's engine costs ~600 ms — then shut down after five idle minutes or when the plugin unloads. ## Quick start **Windows** — from a fresh clone, in PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft .\install.ps1 # or: install.cmd (if .ps1 files are blocked) ``` That finds the Node the harness already ships (no `node`, `npm` or `pnpm` on `PATH` needed), downloads every craft CLI for your platform, and installs the twelve plugins into your DSH profile. Add `-Crafts gridcraft` for one craft, `-List` for a dry run, or `-Verify` to prove it works: ```powershell .\install.ps1 -Crafts gridcraft,wordcraft -Profile desktop -Verify ``` **macOS and Linux** — the same two steps by hand: ```sh git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft # 1. the craft CLIs — macOS, Windows and Linux, no Rust toolchain needed node scripts/install-craft.mjs # …or compile them from source instead (needs Rust, ~1 min per craft): # node scripts/install-craft.mjs --from-source # 2. install the plugins into a DSH profile, then restart it node scripts/install-into-profile.mjs --profile web ``` Both platforms run the same Node scripts; `install.ps1` only adds Node discovery and PowerShell-friendly defaults. Nothing is installed machine-wide and no shell profile is modified. Or install a single craft from npm, straight into a profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft ``` Each craft is its own package: `dsh-artcraft-plugin-` for `cadcraft`, `gridcraft`, `soundcraft`, `deckcraft`, `wordcraft`, `photocraft`, `lightcraft`, `pdfcraft`, `vectorcraft`, `effectcraft`, `filmcraft` and `designcraft`. Then just ask: > *"Open the CADCraft sample floor plan and export a PNG of the kitchen."* > *"Take the demo song in SoundCraft, drop the kick 6 dB and bounce it."* > *"Render page 3 of this PDF at 300 dpi."* Full instructions, configuration and troubleshooting: **[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)**
Requirements - **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` — on Windows the harness's own bundled Node is found automatically, so you do not need it on `PATH` - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) profile - **macOS, Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04** — the installer picks the right build, and nothing else is required (no Rust, no `unzip`, no `tar`, no `npm`, no `pnpm`) Nothing else. The craft apps are **not** built from source; step 1 downloads signed release binaries.
## Verify it yourself ```sh node scripts/verify.mjs ``` Every craft must locate its binary, load its live catalog, expose the right tool set, complete an MCP handshake, and produce a non-empty artifact from a real headless run: ``` craft binary catalog tools mcp run cadcraft cadcraft-cli 0.5.0 305 (live) 8 11 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.dxf (34140 B) deckcraft deckcraft-cli 0.5.0 226 (live) 8 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.deckcraft (7471 B) designcraft designcraft-cli 0.6.0 446 (live) 6 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.pdf (2028 B) effectcraft effectcraft-cli 0.8.0 669 (live) 8 27 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.ecproj (732438 B) filmcraft filmcraft-cli 0.6.0 693 (live) 8 17 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.fcproj (3264 B) gridcraft gridcraft-cli 0.5.0 315 (live) 8 21 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.xlsx (7682 B) lightcraft lightcraft-cli 0.6.0 296 (live) 7 318 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.bin (108535 B) pdfcraft pdfcraft-cli 0.7.1 161 (live) 8 161 tools (doc_list ok) ok → out.pdf (802 B) photocraft photocraft-c

plugins.description: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP: no plugin code, 16 of the 21 upstream tools by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp-lite

**Config-only bridge from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP).**

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

It mounts the MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness and points it at the upstream Windows-MCP server over stdio. The whole integration is [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) — about 25 lines, no JavaScript, and you can read it to the end before you install it.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ mcp__windows__Snapshot / Click / Type / ...
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (ships with DeepSeek Harness)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UI Automation tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What this deliberately does not do

These are the design decisions, not a missing-feature list:

- **No Host plugin.** There is no `index.js`. Nothing of ours runs inside your harness process.
- **No web routes.** This plugin adds no HTTP endpoint, so it adds no unauthenticated attack surface and no reason to keep your web host on loopback beyond what you already chose.
- **No state file.** No `~/.dsh/...state.json`, no browser storage keys.
- **No installer that writes to your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream server *in your own terminal*, and never edits a profile patch for you.
- **No runtime dependency and no build step.** `dependencies` is empty; there is nothing to compile and no `allowBuilds` approval to grant.
- **No absolute path for your machine.** The bridge invokes `uvx` from `PATH`; a test in this repo fails the build if a machine-specific path appears in a published file.
- **No `peerDependencies`.** The row *names* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; it never imports it, and DSH resolves shipped packages from its own installation. This follows DSH's own `templates/mcp` bundle shape, which declares none. A peer range would be a hard activation gate whose SemVer prerelease rules silently reject valid hosts; `engines.dsh` declares the host range for the storefront instead.
- **No `screenshots.json`.** There is no interface to photograph. Declaring artwork for a configuration file would be decoration, not evidence; the storefront falls back to whatever it can extract.

If you want an in-app dependency installer, a default-off "Computer Use" toggle, or a doctor tool, other plugins in this ecosystem provide those. This one trades them for being small enough to audit in one screen — which matters more than usual for a plugin that hands over your keyboard, mouse and screen.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.** The upstream server is Windows-only.
- **DeepSeek Harness with the in-box MCP client bridge.** Declared range: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; the author verified this plugin on **0.2.0-rc.2** (desktop).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH.** `uvx` starts the upstream server and builds its isolated environment. If you installed uv with its official installer, this is already true.
- Optional: **a model that accepts image input**, if you want `Screenshot` to arrive as a real image. Without it the bridge degrades the image to a text diagnostic; `Snapshot` returns plain text and needs no vision at all.

## Install

From the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter one of

```text
dsh-windows-mcp-lite                                # npm package
github:sheilacraig/dsh-windows-mcp-lite             # GitHub repository
C:\path\to\a\local\checkout                         # absolute path
```

From a CLI-owned profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-windows-mcp-lite
```

The Electron desktop profile belongs to the app; install through its plugin panel there.

Then restart DSH, so the new patch layer composes at startup.

## First run is the slow one

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for the upstream server the first time, which downloads a few tens of megabytes of Python dependencies. On a slow link that is minutes, and the bridge gives up on the initial connection long before that; after the dependencies are cached, startup is quick.

Do it outside the harness instead, where there is no timeout:

```sh
npm run prewarm
```

The script runs `uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve --exclude-tools ...` — the same argv the bridge uses — speaks `initialize` + `tools/list` to it, prints the server identity, the time it took, and the exact tool list, then exits. It is the same process the bridge will start, so a successful run means the harness side has nothing left to download or discover. With the environment warm, the author's run reached `initialize` in 2.1 s.

## What the model gets

**16 tools**, named `mcp__windows__<Tool>`. Upstream 0.8.8 publishes 21; this plugin excludes five by default (see [Least privilege](#least-privilege-by-default)).

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Screenshot` | Screen capture with cursor position and window list |
| `Snapshot` | Full desktop state: accessibility tree, interactive elements, scrollable regions |
| `DisplayInventory` | Display layout, work areas, DPI |
| `Click`, `Move`, `Scroll` | Mouse input, including explicit drag |
| `Type`, `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `Wait`, `WaitFor` | Fixed delay, or poll the UI until a condition holds |
| `MultiSelect`, `MultiEdit` | Bulk selection / bulk text entry |
| `Clipboard` | Read and set clipboard content |
| `Notification` | Windows toast notifications |
| `App` | Launch an application, resize or focus a window |
| `ControlStatus` | Who owns the desktop right now — upstream cannot exclude this one |

## Verify

1. Run `npm run prewarm` once (above). It proves the server and the pinned version.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory`. It only reads display geometry — it does not click or type.
3. Then `mcp__windows__Snapshot` for the accessibility tree as text.

## Least privilege by default

`--exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape` — five upstream tools stay off, because DeepSeek Harness already owns shell, file, registry and process access under its own approval policy and sandbox. Enabling upstream's copies would add a second path to the same capabilities with none of those controls.

To change the set, override the row in your profile patch (see below). Removing `--exclude-tools` restores all 21 tools.

## Configuration

Every default lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change one, override the row in **your profile's** patch — do not edit the installed copy:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: windows-mcp-lite
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape,App"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
```

Two things about that override, both of which cost people time:

- **A patch replaces the entire `config` object; it does not deep-merge.** Every key you leave out is a key you delete. `serverName` and `transport` are required, `command` is required for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`.
- **`serverName` decides every tool name** (`mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`). Changing it renames the whole tool set and invalidates prompt-cache prefixes.

**Only one Windows-MCP bridge per profile.** Two rows using the same `serverName` conflict, and the second one fails at load. Disable any other Windows-MCP plugin in the same profile before enabling this one.

# dsh-phone-inbox

The session's inbound phone (WeChat bridge) attachment inbox: list the attachments **this conversation** actually received, and adopt one into the workspace on demand.

## The problem this closes

`dsh-wechat` saves inbound phone media to `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile/` — outside the session workspace — and writes the absolute path into a plain text block. Two consequences follow, and neither is visible to the user:

1. **Workspace-confined tools cannot read it.** `dsh-data-quality` rejects any path that escapes the session workspace (`path-escape`), so "I sent you a CSV, profile it" fails even though the file is right there.
2. **The file name is destroyed.** The bridge names the file `${Date.now()}-${rand4hex}-${name.replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_")}`, so `材料.csv` lands on disk as `__.csv`. The user cannot recognize their own file.

`dsh-phone-inbox` adds no new channel and copies nothing by default. It makes the session's own inbound list addressable, and it restores the name the bridge mangled — from the `[收到文件: <name>]` marker the bridge already writes.

## What you get

| Tool | Question it answers |
|---|---|
| `inbox_list` | "Where is the file I just sent you from my phone?" |
| `inbox_adopt` | "Put it somewhere my workspace-confined tools can read it." |

Both tools are registered by the function plugin, so they appear in the model's tool list as soon as the bundle row is mounted.

## Quick start

```sh
# 1. Mount the plugin (a bundle row in the target profile)
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
```

Then, in a session that received a phone attachment:

```text
inbox_list                                   # the paths this session received
inbox_adopt { "path": "<the path from inbox_list>" }
```

`inbox_adopt` returns `relativePath` (for example `phone-inbox/材料.csv`). Pass **that** to a workspace-confined tool such as `data_profile`; pass the original host path only to consumers that accept any absolute path.

## Install & uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-phone-inbox
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-phone-inbox
```

The plugin has **no runtime dependencies** (`dependencies` is empty). Its only peers are the host packages it is built against; see the `peerDependencies` block in `package.json`.

## Compatibility

| Engine | Range |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-alpha.1` |

The host peer range is the ecosystem's canonical six-clause OR range (see `dsh-plugin-kit/data/peer-range.json`). The host evaluates `peerDependencies` at preflight and **silently disables** a plugin row whose range does not admit the running version, so a wrong range looks like "the plugin mounted and does nothing". `engines.dsh` is declarative only — the host does not read it.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; the table lists the default. See `cordis.patch.yml` for the same values with inline comments.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` mounts no service and no tools. |
| `inboxDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh-wechat/tempfile` | Directory the bridge drops inbound media into. Empty derives the bridge's own default; set it when the bridge's `storageDir` was moved. |
| `maxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries `inbox_list` returns. The MVP contract is "the session's most recent few". |
| `provider` | `session` | Which registered provider answers: `session` (this conversation's own messages) or `tempdir` (`session` plus a scan of `inboxDir`). |
| `allowTempdirScan` | `false` | Enables the directory scan at all. Off because `inboxDir` is global. |
| `tempdirScanMaxItems` | `5` | Cap on entries a scan may contribute. |
| `tempdirScanMaxAgeMs` | `3600000` | Age ceiling for a scanned file; `0` disables the filter. |
| `markers` | see below | Marker wording per media kind, as `RegExp` sources. |
| `defaultSubdir` | `phone-inbox` | Workspace subdirectory `inbox_adopt` writes into. |
| `restoreOriginalName` | `true` | Use the sender's recovered original name as the adopted file name. |
| `writeChannel` | `auto` | `auto` (fs service for text, node:fs otherwise) · `fs` (host fs service only) · `node` (bytes directly). |
| `registerAttachment` | `false` | Also register adopted bytes as a durable host attachment. Attachment objects are never garbage-collected. |

The `markers` default wording, per media kind — each value is a `RegExp` source whose **first capture group is the path**:

- `image.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.path` — `` (?:文件已保存到|文件路径):\s*(\S+) ``
- `file.name` — `` \[收到文件:\s*([^\]\r\n]+)\] ``
- `video.path` — `` 文件已保存到:\s*(\S+) ``

Marker wording is a **soft contract** with the bridge: it writes the path into prose, and the prose can change between bridge releases without notice. The patterns are configuration precisely so a wording change is a config edit rather than a plugin release.

## Tools & surfaces

```ts
inbox_list({
  limit?: number,            // default: config.maxItems
  includeTempdir?: boolean,  // only honoured when allowTempdirScan is true
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, source, inboxDir, items[], attachments, deriveMessages, emptyReason?, emptyDetail?, tempdirScan, unresolvedAttachmentBlocks }`, or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

```ts
inbox_adopt({
  path: string,              // required: exactly what inbox_list reported
  name?: string,             // default: the recovered original name
  subdir?: string,           // default: config.defaultSubdir
  channel?: 'auto' | 'fs' | 'node',
  overwrite?: boolean,       // default false: a duplicate gets a -1 suffix
  register?: boolean,        // default: config.registerAttachment
})
```

Returns `{ ok: true, item }` with `hostPath`, `workspacePath`, `relativePath`, `bytes`, `sha256`, `copyMethod`, `nameRestored`, `sourceLeafName`, and `attachmentId`/`attachmentHostPath` when registered; or `{ ok: false, reason, detail }`.

The plugin also appends one system-prompt section (`phone-inbox`, order 320) so the model knows the capability exists, and subscribes to `session/event` for `user/message` observation. Neither is required for correctness: the history read is authoritative on every call.

## Permissions & data

- **Reads** `inboxDir` and the calling session's own messages. Nothing else.
- **Writes** only inside the session workspace (`path.resolve` + a separator-aware containment check), and only when `inbox_adopt` is called.
- **Refuses** a source path that is not under `inboxDir`, a `subdir` that escapes the workspace, and a name that could traverse. The `path` argument comes from the model and is never trusted.
- **Does not scan** the shared inbox directory unless `allowTempdirScan` is explicitly enabled; when it does, every entry it contributes is stamped `source: "tempdir"`.
- **Never overwrites** silently. A duplicate destination gets a `-1`, `-2`, … suffix unless `overwrite: true`.
- **Registers nothing** as a durable attachment unless asked; registration copies bytes into the host's attachment store, which has no garbage collection.

## Security boundaries

- Reads are not fenced by the host's fs sandbox (the fence wraps only `writeText`/`editText`), so this plugin enforces its own containment on **both** ends of the copy.
- The `fs` write channel goes through `ctx.fs.writeText` with the session-scoped sandbox policy, so a confining backend fences it exactly as it fences the `write` tool. `node` bypasses that fence by construction; it exists because `ctx.fs` has no byte-write API. The returned `copyMethod` always says which one ran.
- `auto` prefers the fs service for text and falls back to `node:fs`; the fallback reason is recorded and the channel is reported, never implied.
- The tempdir scan cannot prove which conversation a file belongs to. That is why it is off by default and why its items carry their own `source`.
- The bridge's inbox directory is not guaranteed to be private (a bridge refactor removed the explicit `0o700`/`0o600` handling). This plugin does not assume otherwise.

## Known limitations

- **A path containing a literal space is truncated** at the space by the default marker wording. The capture is `(\S+)` because that is what stops it f

# DSHM 插件 · DeepSeek Harness 远程连接 简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md) [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile) · **DSHM 电脑插件** · [DSHM 中转服务](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay) **DSHM 插件**安装在电脑的官方 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 中，将工作区、聊天会话、执行结果和审批同步到 [DSHM 安卓客户端](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile)。手机远程续聊与决策，电脑执行任务；无需修改或重建 DSH。 [GitHub 一条命令安装](#安装插件并配对手机) · [下载插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/tag/v0.1.84-latest.0) · [DSH 兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) · [常见问题](#常见问题)

![DSHM 插件：把电脑上的工作，连接到手机。](./docs/images/hero.png) ## 远程会话与设备管理功能 | 能力 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 会话同步 | 查看工作区与历史、创建聊天、发送消息、切换模型、处理审批。 | | 设备管理 | 五分钟有效的一次性配对链接；核对指纹、批准、拒绝与撤销。 | | 访问控制 | 开关远程连接；电脑管理权限另行授予或收回。 | | 扩展 | 通过允许的接口转发文件、工具结果与兼容插件局部界面。 | ![DeepSeek Harness 中的 DSHM 插件设置：电脑已连接，手机配对等待批准。](./docs/images/desktop-pairing.png) [图片来源](./docs/images/README.md)。真实插件页面，使用演示设备。 ## 安装插件并配对手机 [插件构建与下载](./docs/releases.md) · [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/actions/workflows/plugin-build.yml) · [发行版本](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases) **官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` 共用同一 GitHub 安装包：** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin ``` `dsh plugin` 是 DSH 官方命令。若你从 DSH 源码目录启动，使用 `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/dshm-plugin`。仓库包含预编译产物，安装时不需要编译器、相邻后端目录或额外构建许可；正式使用建议复制市场提供的 `#完整提交号` 命令，固定到已扫描版本。[GitHub 安装与版本说明](./docs/github-install.md) 仓库默认安装包 `0.1.84-latest.0` 支持上述两个明确版本。alpha.1 仍需使用对应的 `.tgz`，不能使用默认命令。三个版本的插件包已公开发布，直接下载无需登录 GitHub： | 电脑 DSH 版本 | 直接下载 | | --- | --- | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | [rc.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.84-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.84-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.1` | [alpha.1 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.84-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.84-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.1.tgz) | | `0.2.1-alpha.2` | [alpha.2 插件包](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.84-latest.0/dshm-plugin-0.1.84-latest.0-dsh-0.2.1-alpha.2.tgz) | 连接 rc.2 / alpha.2 请使用 [DSHM 0.1.0-preview.2 APK](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0-preview.2/DSHM-0.1.0-preview.2.apk)；该 APK 不连接 alpha.1。旧 preview.1 仍只连接 alpha.2。[双版本验证与手机要求](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) · [完整配对步骤](./docs/usage.md) 1. 安装匹配 DSH 版本的插件，运行 `pnpm dsh web`；提示下次启动加载时，重启 DSH。 2. 填写中转根地址、电脑名称，注册电脑并开启连接。 3. 手机领取配对链接，电脑核对指纹并批准。 4. 手机打开已有工作区，继续会话或创建新聊天。 **推荐[自建中转](https://github.com/KKUCODES/dshm-relay)**；也可填[公共服务](http://118.31.20.47:18787) `http://118.31.20.47:18787`。开放注册免密，设备仍需配对与批准，无需用户账号。 公共服务使用 HTTP，传输未加密。敏感内容建议自建 HTTPS。电脑和 DSH 必须保持运行。[完整安装步骤](./docs/usage.md) ## 更换中转服务地址 点击插件设置页 **“修改服务地址”**： - **同一后端换地址：** 换域名、端口或 HTTPS，验证后保留电脑身份和授权。 - **更换后端：** 重新注册和配对；个人模式需新密钥，旧服务授权不会自动撤销。 ![DSHM 电脑插件：修改中转服务地址并选择保留设备授权或重新配对。](./docs/images/change-server.png) 取消或验证失败保留原连接，保存成功保留启停状态。手机需新链接重新配对。[详细步骤](./docs/usage.md#5-修改服务地址) ## 当前状态 | 范围 | 版本与已验内容 | | --- | --- | | GitHub 安装 | `0.1.84-latest.0`，同一份预编译产物支持官方 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2`；两版均已通过实际官方安装、设置页与卸载。[双版本记录](./compatibility/latest-upstream/market-baseline.md) | | Release 下载 | rc.2、alpha.1、alpha.2 的精确匹配归档已公开发布；三版云端构建及匿名下载校验通过，下载时不能混用。[构建说明](./docs/releases.md) | | 修改服务地址 | `0.1.81-latest.0` 的[独立设置页验证](./compatibility/latest-upstream/gateway-settings.md)，不代表完整 Remote 重验。 | | 核心 Remote | 官方 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`＋插件 `0.1.80-latest.0`＋原配套 Android，在 Web + MuMu 完成本地验收。[支持清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md) | 当前为公开预发布。GitHub 安装与构建通过不等于已完成新包的全量手机兼容验收；Electron、真机、完整公网及其他版本、插件、模型需另验。 手机不创建电脑工作区、不输入命令、不转发电脑 localhost 网站。 ## 常见问题 ### 应该选择哪个 DSH 版本的插件包？ 先查看电脑的 DSH 版本。GitHub 默认安装支持 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-alpha.2`；下载 `.tgz` 时，包名中的 `dsh-<版本>` 必须对应电脑版本，例如 `dshm-plugin-0.1.84-latest.0-dsh-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz`。alpha.1 使用自己的归档。升级 DSH 后重新核对[兼容清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md)，不要把未验版本默认视为兼容。 ### 配对链接发给手机后就能访问电脑吗？ 还需要电脑核对手机的公钥指纹并批准。链接五分钟内有效，领取后失效；已批准设备可以在电脑插件页撤销，电脑管理权限另行授予。 ### 手机续聊必须获得电脑管理权限吗？ 不需要。批准设备后即可使用聊天与任务操作；管理电脑工作区、插件和设置需要另行授予管理权限，也可以单独收回。操作入口见[管理访问](./docs/usage.md#4-管理访问)。 ## 开发与文档 TypeScript + Cordis，React 配置页。GitHub Actions 自动准备固定后端协议与已发布 SDK，分别打包三个 DSH 版本，并核对提交的 GitHub 安装产物与源码一致。`lib/` 是安装入口，`dist/` 仅作旧开发输出，见[自动构建说明](./docs/releases.md)与开发指南。 ```text src/ 电脑插件、会话适配与配置页 lib/ 已编译 GitHub 安装入口，随源码提交并由 CI 复核 scripts/ 构建与审查脚本 tests/ 插件测试与夹具 docs/ 使用、开发和技术文档 compatibility/ 版本支持与兼容验证资料 ``` - [安装与使用](./docs/usage.md)：连接、批准与撤销。 - [开发指南](./docs/development.md)：依赖、构建与版本。 - [下载与发版](./docs/releases.md)：Actions 插件包与发行草稿。 - [GitHub 安装与市场投稿](./docs/github-install.md)：官方命令、固定提交及版本要求。 - [支持清单](./compatibility/latest-upstream/official-support.md)：已验与未验范围。 - [知识库](./docs/project-knowledge/catalog.md)：架构、接口与验证资料。 ## 许可证 本项目原创代码采用 [MIT 许可证](./LICENSE)。第三方代码、依赖和素材遵循各自的许可证与使用条件。

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention)


**关键词**：日志留存 · 日志保留 · 审计日志 · 网络日志 · 网络安全法 · 六个月 · 留存不少于六个月 · 日志合规
**Keywords**: log retention · audit log retention · network log · six months retention · China cybersecurity law
**日志留存合规** —— 检查日志是否开着、是否记了该记的、是否留够**法定的 6 个月**。

## 不装它会怎样

你的日志轮转配的是 `maxDays: 7`（日志库的常见默认值）—— 排障够用。

半年后出了事，监管问：**这半年的网络日志呢？**

《网络安全法》第二十一条要求**留存不少于六个月**。日志已经在第 8 天被轮转删掉了。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 留存期 < 180 天 |
| 🔴 高 | 日志级别被关闭（`off`/`none`/`silent`）|
| 🔴 高 | 日志里打印了口令/令牌的**值** |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到任何日志方案 |

## 排障日志 ≠ 合规日志

```
排障：maxDays: 7        够了
合规：maxDays: >= 180   法定下限，且不能被应用进程随意删
```

两者通常**需要分开**：业务日志短留存，审计日志长留存、单独存放。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-log-retention
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-cn-log-retention --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-cn-log-retention --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-cn-log-retention --html r.html   # HTML 报告
```

![dsh-cn-log-retention 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/report.png)

![dsh-cn-log-retention 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/demo.png)

![dsh-cn-log-retention 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-log-retention/rules.png)

## 边界

- **不做缺项判定** —— 没有轮转配置不代表日志没留 180 天（可能由部署层统一留存）。
- **只看应用层** —— 数据库审计、网络设备、操作系统日志不在范围。
- **不校验不可篡改性** —— 那需要看存储层设计。
- 与其他插件分工：[dsh-cn-mlps](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) 做等保其它项。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 22 个）

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-minor-guard

**未成年人保护** —— 查不满 14 周岁个人信息有没有监护人同意、专门规则、年龄门槛。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 App 有注册、有青少年模式，代码里这样写：

```js
const teenMode = true;      // 默认开启
async function register(phone) {
  await db.insert('users', { phone, teen_mode: teenMode });
}
```

**看着挺贴心，实际踩了三条：**

```
《个人信息保护法》第三十一条
  —— 处理不满十四周岁未成年人个人信息的，
     应当取得父母或者其他监护人的同意，
     并制定【专门的】个人信息处理规则
```

1. **没有监护人同意** —— 同意必须来自监护人，不是孩子本人
2. **没有年龄识别** —— 你都不知道用户是不是儿童，怎么触发监护人同意？
3. **青少年模式默认开启** —— 用户什么都没做就进入了该模式

## 关键词
**关键词**：未成年人保护 · 儿童个人信息 · 监护人同意 · 青少年模式 · 年龄识别 · 个保法 31 条 · 儿童隐私
**Keywords**: minor protection · children privacy · guardian consent · parental consent · teen mode · PIPL

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 有未成年人功能但**找不到监护人同意** · 找不到**专门的儿童保护规则** |
| 🟡 中 | 有注册但**找不到年龄识别** · 青少年模式**默认开启** |

## 一条规则只在特定项目上运行

**`MINOR-NO-GUARDIAN-CONSENT` 只在检测到未成年人相关功能时才跑**（识别标志：青少年模式 / teenMode / 儿童模式…）。

普通项目跑这条就是误报 —— 这是引擎的**条件规则**能力（`check.when`）。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-minor-guard
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-minor-guard
```

![dsh-minor-guard 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-minor-guard/report.png)

![dsh-minor-guard 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-minor-guard/demo.png)

![dsh-minor-guard 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-minor-guard/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-minor-guard --demo
dsh-minor-guard --list-rules
dsh-minor-guard --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **只看代码，不看实际产品** —— 监护人同意可能是线下短信流程，代码里看不到。
- **「默认开启」识别是启发式的** —— 它会**跳过已经实现监护人同意流程的文件**
  （那种情况下的开启是合规的）。文件级排除，粒度较粗。
- **年龄识别只认常见写法**（年龄字段 / 出生日期 / birthday）—— 自定义字段名会漏。
- **不覆盖行业特殊规定**（如游戏防沉迷的时长限制），只做个人信息保护维度。
- 与 [dsh-consent-guard](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) 分工：
  那个查**一般用户**的同意机制，这个专查 **未成年人**的特殊要求。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**


---

plugins.description: DSH native plugin: audit GitHub repos for fake stars, stargazer bot farms and hollow codebases using CMU StarScout heuristics, plus static supply-chain and sensitive-permission inspection.
plugins.readme_text:
# @suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor

```
⚠️ 本仓库是**自动生成的发布镜像**，每次发布都会整体覆盖 `main`。
**唯一事实来源 / single source of truth:** [Suxeca/dsh-plugin → packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor)
请勿在本仓库提交代码或 PR —— 改为修改源仓库中的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，本仓库的内容会被下一次发布覆盖。
```

**本仓库只发布可安装产物**（`lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`locale/`、`package.json`），**不含 `src/` 与 `tests/`**：审计器要检测的那些标记（安装钩子名、宿主进程 API、越狱口令等）在本仓库的产物中一律由运行时拼装生成（源仓库 `src/tokens.ts`），所以任何静态扫描都不会在本仓库里读到它自己的检测表 —— 否则它会扫到自己、把自己判成 CRITICAL（F 级），并让安装门禁对使用者误报。源码与唯一事实来源仍在源仓库。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生插件：基于 CMU StarScout 启发式指标审计 GitHub 假星 / 水军 / 空壳仓库，并对 DSH 插件做供应链投毒与敏感权限静态预检。

## 安装 / Install

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor
```

无需构建：`lib/` 已预编译随仓库发布（prebuilt）。包名 `@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，由 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明装配。

## 功能 / What it does

- **假星与互动比率审计** — Fork/Star、Watcher/Star 比率异常检测，含大仓（>50k stars）通知疲劳校准与豁免模型。
- **空壳与脉冲刷量** — 高星但代码体积 < 30 KB 的空壳仓库、活跃跨度不足 2 天的增星脉冲、0-Issue 异常增星（维护者关闭 Issues 时豁免）。
- **点星水军抽样** — 并发抽检最新 Stargazers 的 Profile，识别「三无空白号」与「新注册闪电水军」。
- **供应链投毒预检** — 经 GitHub Raw CDN 零配额静态拉取 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`，识别高危安装钩子（远程下载、`eval`、混淆、凭据窃取）与 DSH 敏感权限（密钥服务注入、插件管理服务、宿主进程 API、工具执行前置钩子）。
- **安装拦截门禁** — 通过工具执行前置钩子（pre-execution hook）监听插件安装动作与 `bash` 中的 `git clone` / `npm install github:...`，命中风险时弹出 DSH 原生审批卡片。

## 配置项 / Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: repo-auditor
      name: '@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor'
      config:
        token: ""               # GitHub PAT（可选）
        sampleSize: 5           # 水军账号抽样数量
        enableInstallGate: true # 安装拦截门禁开关
```

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | `string` | `""` | GitHub Personal Access Token（可选）。留空时按四级顺序自动探测：`config.token` → DSH 凭据服务 → 环境变量 `GITHUB_TOKEN` → 本地 `~/.bashrc` / `~/.env` / `.env`。未鉴权时受 60 次/小时配额限制，鉴权后为 5000 次/小时。 |
| `sampleSize` | `number` | `5` | 水军账号抽样数量；仅在仓库一阶指标可疑（评分 < 85）时才触发抽样，用于保护 API 配额。 |
| `enableInstallGate` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否启用工具执行前置钩子（双轨安全拦截门禁：星标信度低 或 供应链/敏感权限中高风险 → 弹卡审批）。 |

紧急逃生通道 / escape hatch：在命令前加环境变量 `SKIP_REPO_`＋`AUDIT=1`（拼接后即为跳过标记）可跳过安装门禁。

## 出处与致谢 / Attribution

启发式指标来自 CMU 论文 **"Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars in GitHub: A Growing Spiral of Popularity Contagion, Suspicious Promotion, and Unwanted Projects"**（StarScout）— [arXiv:2412.13459](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13459)。本插件是 DSH / Cordis 架构下的原生重实现，与论文作者无隶属关系。

## 构建与来源 / Build & source

本仓库为预编译产物，安装无需构建。源码与开发文档位于 [Suxeca/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin) 的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`；发布流程见该仓库的 `scripts/release-auditor.sh`。

## 许可 / License

MIT License — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。该文件由发布脚本从源仓库根目录自动复制，与 `package.json` 的 `license` 字段保持一致。

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作浏览器与电脑：以插件形式装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，附一键依赖安装、macOS 系统权限引导与 MCP 连接自检。
plugins.readme_text:
# Browser & Computer Control (`myspace-dsh-browser-computer`)

[English](https://github.com/fegnze/myspace-dsh-browser-computer/blob/main/README.md) | [中文](https://github.com/fegnze/myspace-dsh-browser-computer/blob/main/docs/zh.md)

Turns "let DSH drive a browser and a computer" into a plugin that **works the moment it is
installed**. The plugin body *is* the two MCP rows in `cordis.patch.yml` — `playwright-mcp`
and `peekaboo-mcp`. That follows the official "configuration-only bundle" recipe
(`templates/mcp` + `references/mcp-bundle.md`): **no Host or Client entry file is required** —
installing it wires both MCP servers into DSH.

Once activated it automatically runs "check environment → install missing dependencies →
check permissions → open the permission panels that need attention", and the UI is just a
status line plus one **Repair** button. It **never writes profile config** (that is the
official plugin manager's exclusive job) and **never changes system permissions** (it only
opens the relevant System Settings panel for you to click).

## What it wires

| Row | Provider | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-mcp` | `@playwright/mcp` | Real-browser control driven by accessibility snapshots and stable refs: navigate, click, fill, tabs, screenshots, network, cookies/storage |
| `peekaboo-mcp` | `@steipete/peekaboo` | Read/write the macOS accessibility tree, screenshots, real mouse and keyboard input (macOS only) |

`command` is resolved at load time via `!!js` to the absolute `npx` that sits next to `node` —
no machine-specific path is hard-coded, and it does not rely on the minimal `PATH` a
Finder/Dock-launched app receives (a bare `npx` cannot be resolved there, so the server dies
silently).

## Install and activation

Pick any one of the three:

```bash
# 1) from npm (recommended: pinned version, reproducible)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add myspace-dsh-browser-computer

# 2) straight from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:fegnze/myspace-dsh-browser-computer

# 3) local development (points at this directory, edits are visible immediately)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<absolute path to this repo>
```

**After installing you must fully quit and reopen the DSH App.** All of this is measured, not
assumed:

- The two MCP rows appear in the config layer immediately after install (`Config.listConfigs`
  shows `playwright-mcp` / `peekaboo-mcp`), but they are **not** materialised into
  `mcp__playwright__*` / `mcp__peekaboo__*` tools in the running session, and no MCP child
  process is spawned.
- The Host half's JavaScript is held by the process module cache: without a restart,
  activation still reports errors from the previous revision.
- The official mcp-bundle recipe itself ends with "install, then call
  `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` to verify".

After the restart, verify by asking the model to call `browser_computer_repair`, by running the
slash command `/browser-computer repair`, or by calling an MCP tool directly (for example
`mcp__playwright__browser_navigate`).

The Client half (the section on the plugin page) needs **one more step: refresh the page**.
Only after the App restarts does the boot graph include this plugin's client entry, so an
already-open page has to be refreshed once to pick it up.

## What it does on its own

Plugin activation (install, or App restart) runs `repair` once, without you clicking anything:

1. **Check environment** — Node / npx / browser binaries / dependency-package caches
2. **Install missing dependencies** — `npx -y <package> --version` warms playwright-mcp and
   peekaboo-mcp; **already-cached packages are never re-downloaded**
3. **Check permissions** — Screen Recording / Accessibility (`--no-remote`, so the state
   belongs to the DSH App's own process chain)
4. **Guide permissions** — if anything is not granted, open the matching System Settings panel
   (it only opens panels; it never grants anything)

The whole pass is idempotent and runs in the background; a failure in any step only writes one
log line and **never breaks activation**. Set `autoRepairOnStart: false` to turn it off.

## UI: a status line and one button

The UI lives on **this plugin's own detail page** (official slot `plugins.detail.section`), not
in the host Settings page — this is the plugin's own health check, not a host preference. The
`Section` component returns `null` for other plugins' subjects (it only renders when
`subject.kind === 'bundle' && subject.pkg.name === <package name>`), so it never leaks onto
other plugin pages.

There are exactly two things:

- **A one-line status** plus a status card (environment / the three permissions / MCP
  connection), read once automatically when the page opens (read-only, no network)
- **One "Repair" button** → `POST /api/repair`: installs missing dependencies, opens the panels
  that need authorisation, and finally verifies the connection

Both endpoints pass two fences: a custom intent header (which blocks cross-site simple
requests) and `connection.admit` (the Host/Origin fence plus browser authentication). The UI
does not `require` any Harness Client package; controls and styles are its own and reference
only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens.

A Client change has been measured to **not** need an App restart: editing `src/client.js`
rebuilds the graph and the live page picks it up (the plugin's entry shows up in
`plugins.detail.section`'s occupants immediately). Only Host changes need a full restart.

## The two actions

| Command | Tool | Side effects | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/browser-computer check` | `browser_computer_check` | none (no network) | local dependencies, macOS permission state, profile wiring conflicts |
| `/browser-computer repair` | `browser_computer_repair` | installs packages, may open panels | install missing dependencies → check and guide permissions → verify the MCP connection (`verify: false` skips that) |

With no argument it runs `repair`. The tool surface is deliberately just these two: tool
schemas are a permanent context cost.

## macOS permissions: the pitfall that wastes half an hour

TCC (System Settings → Privacy & Security) has **no** "Event Synthesizing" switch. That is
Peekaboo's name for a capability it derives; it actually hangs off Accessibility:

| Name in the report | Where in System Settings | What it affects |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Screen Recording | Privacy & Security → Screen Recording | screenshots, window enumeration |
| Accessibility | Privacy & Security → Accessibility | accessibility-tree reads/writes, background clicks |
| Event Synthesizing | same place; it opens automatically once Accessibility is granted | synthetic keyboard, foreground pointer actions |

Two things you must know:

1. **The grant target is the DSH App**, not your terminal. The plugin uses `--no-remote` so
   Peekaboo reports permissions from the local execution environment, which attributes the
   state to the DSH App's process chain. Going through a Peekaboo Bridge/daemon instead is a
   different grant *and* spawns a resident process.
2. **Restart the DSH App after granting.** A TCC change does not necessarily take effect for an
   already-running process.

## Security boundaries (read before installing)

- This plugin's `computer` row passes `--allow-foreground`: **without it, real clicking and
  typing are impossible**. If you only need background accessibility work, delete that single
  argument from `cordis.patch.yml` to reduce the privilege.
- Playwright MCP ships `browser_run_code_unsafe`, which the vendor labels "RCE-equivalent".
  Page content is untrusted input; do not point it at your daily-driver browser profile first.
- The plugin never touches permissions, so the ceiling is entirely your permission preset.
- Context cost: the two packs together contribute roughly 50 tool schemas to every system
  prompt. If that is not worth it, delete the corresponding row from `cordis.patch.yml`.

## Do not wire it twice

If you already added MCP rows with the same `serverName` to
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` by hand, they collide with the rows this plugin
declares: **two MCP instances and

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-intent-title

English | [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

An independent, zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that automatically classifies new conversation intents and names sessions with clean prefixes (e.g., `⚡ 优化｜...`, `🐛 修复｜...`, `✨ 功能｜...`).

## ✨ Features

- **🎯 Automatic Intent Classification**: Evaluates the first user message using lightweight LLM prompts to detect task intent and extract concise subjects.
- **🛡️ Zero UI Invasion**: Pure backend logic provider. Does not inject any frontend CSS, sidebar overrides, or custom themes. Perfectly compatible with `dsh-better-sidebar` and native DSH Web UI.
- **🔒 Safe & Non-Intrusive**: Only triggers once on the first turn. Any manual renaming by the user immediately locks and will never be overwritten.

## 📋 Intent Categories

| Type | Prefix & Emoji | Example Generated Title |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`optimize`** | `⚡ 优化｜...` | `⚡ 优化｜提升循环性能与内存占用` |
| **`fix`** | `🐛 修复｜...` | `🐛 修复｜排查登录接口401问题` |
| **`feature`** | `✨ 功能｜...` | `✨ 功能｜实现OAuth2鉴权模块` |
| **`explore`** | `🔍 探索｜...` | `🔍 探索｜调研WebAssembly在前端的应用` |
| **`design`** | `🎨 设计｜...` | `🎨 设计｜深模块架构重构方案` |
| **`research`** | `🔬 研究｜...` | `🔬 研究｜多智能体协作框架评测` |
| **`docs`** | `📝 文档｜...` | `📝 文档｜编写API使用说明与规范` |

plugins.description: For DSH plugin development: runtime diagnostics and in-place fixes your agent can run itself.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-plugin-debugging

Let your DSH agent inspect and fix its own runtime

让 DSH Agent 自检自修它身处的运行时

Per-version changes → Releases

简体中文 · English

--- An artifact is read at a particular moment, and that moment decides what you must do after changing it. Config is re-read on every change; a process loads code once at startup; the browser swaps assets by fingerprint. When a change "doesn't work", the first question is which of those three you are looking at. ## What it does Installing it gives the model the tools to answer that question, and one skill carrying the reasoning behind them. - **Classify what a change needs** — live, restart, or hot reload, probed against the running profile rather than guessed. - **Check whether a plugin loaded** — bundle membership, mount form, and the Loader tree, separating observed from inferred evidence. - **Tell "not running" from "not authenticated"** — connection refused and 401 get opposite advice, so they must not be the same answer. - **Show what a profile resolved to** — the composed tree plus the diagnostics that explain it. - **Swap one mounted entry to the code on disk** — in place, no restart, rolled back on failure. - **Sign a browser-session cookie** — so a script or CLI client can authenticate against your own instance. - **List the DSH hosts running on this machine** — a port is only claimed as DSH when the unauthenticated `GET /` returns the exact DSH body; "could not probe" is reported separately from "not DSH". - **Restart this host when a change needs it** — four deterministic gates first, then approval, then the marker, then the relaunch and the exit. The skill behind them carries the installation forms, credential acquisition, process identification, and isolated instances. **The tools are accelerators; where one is ambiguous, the skill text wins.** **Pointing at another instance.** The file-based tools (`dsh_dump_config`, `dsh_check_effect_mode`, `dsh_diagnose_plugin_load`, `dsh_sign_cookie`) take a `dshHome` argument, so you can read a second instance's disk evidence without restarting anything. Path resolution *and* the spawned `dsh` subprocess both use that home, and the output says which one it read (`dshHomeSource: tool-argument`) — the value is never silently reported as the configured default. Discovery tools can only hand you an authority (`host:port`); nothing maps an authority to a `dshHome`, so you supply the path. Two tools deliberately do **not** take it: `dsh_check_auth` answers about an authority (it already has `host`/`port`), and `dsh_hot_reload` swaps modules in **this** process's memory — that cannot cross into another instance. `dsh_restart` does not take it either, and that is the sharper case: it kills the host it runs in, so there is no "other instance" it could be aimed at. `dsh_diagnose_plugin_load` splits its answer accordingly: disk evidence belongs to the home you passed, while the Loader-tree half is **this process only**. ## Install ```shell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-debugging ``` From source: ```shell git clone https://github.com/dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-plugin-debugging.git cd dsh-plugin-debugging npm install && npm run build dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD" ``` ⚠️ The `npm install` step is not optional: with a `link:` install the dependencies come from the repository itself, and skipping it makes the plugin show up as not running (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`). Restart `dsh --profile web` for the install to take effect. Requirements: Node `>= 20`, and a DSH range that satisfies [package.json](package.json) — the only source of truth for the supported range. ## Safety and boundaries - The diagnostics tools read files an instance already has, and produce no credentials. - They restart nothing and rewrite no profile. They write nothing to `DSH_HOME` — **machine-checked**: the moment a write targets host data (`profiles` / `sessions` / `storages` / `logs` / `cache` / `attachments` / `backups` / `integrations` / `mcp` / `settings.yaml` / `.credentials.yaml` …) or takes `DSH_HOME` as its target, `npm test` fails. The **one** exception is this plugin's own namespace, `$DSH_HOME//` — exactly that one top-level segment; anything below it is free. - `dsh_hot_reload` touches only the **running module tree**; it writes no profile, writes nothing to `DSH_HOME`, and kills no process. - `dsh_sign_cookie` reads your local signing key to sign a cookie for your own instance. It sends no request and writes nothing; the cookie value is deliberately **not** returned. - `dsh_restart` is the one **irreversible** action: it exits the host you are debugging. It is gated by four deterministic checks (restart loop, other busy sessions and jobs, an unparseable composition, an undeterminable launch command) and then by a fifth, separate one — the **approval policy**, read first and only asked about when it is `ask`. `never` means prompts are off, so asking there would be refused by construction; that is why the policy is read before deciding whether to prompt. Writing the marker needs a second, independent gate: this plugin's own namespace is outside the default file sandbox, so the write is made with `danger-full-access`. Both gates are reported in the output. The relaunch goes through the Windows task scheduler; on a platform where no relaunch route has been measured, the tool refuses **before** it writes anything. ## Platform support Port-based process identification covers Windows, Linux and macOS. When no usable command is found it reports that it could not check — deliberately not "no listener", because those are opposite conclusions. The two weaker fallbacks may name a listener without naming its process; that stays reported as unidentified rather than as an empty list. Everything else is platform-neutral, with one exception: `dsh_restart` can only **relaunch** on Windows, where the task-scheduler route has been measured. Elsewhere it refuses before it writes anything — it will not write a marker and then discover it cannot bring the host back. ## Configuration There is no settings card: these fields belong to the plugin's config in the profile composition. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME`, else `/.dsh` | Where the instance keeps profiles, logs and credentials. | | `profile` | `$DSH_PROFILE`, else the default profile | Which profile the tools inspect. | | `port` | `0` | Host port to probe; `0` finds the listening port. | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Tool budget for a quick workload: a file read, one spawned command, or one HTTP probe. | | `schemaDumpTimeoutMs` | `240000` | Tool budget for the one tool that runs `--dump-config-schema` (measured 10.

plugins.description: SessionRelay project memory for DeepSeek Harness — automatic brief injection, project auto-detection, and two-stage safe binding. Offline self-contained.
plugins.readme_text:
# SessionRelay × DeepSeek Harness (DSH) integration

A native DSH plugin that brings SessionRelay project memory into DSH's system
prompt — the equivalent of the SessionStart hook that CLI-shaped clients
(ZCode, Claude Code) get for free.

**[中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · [SessionRelay upstream](https://github.com/EwanJasper/SessionRelay)**

## Why this exists

SessionRelay is an MCP server, so it can be *queried* by any MCP client. But an
MCP server cannot *inject* anything into a conversation: the `initialize`
response carries no `instructions`, no `resources`, and no `prompts` (verified
against `srelay serve` directly). Anything that appears in the model's context
without the model asking for it must be placed there by the client.

CLI-shaped clients get this almost for free: their process working directory
*is* the project root, so a SessionStart hook can resolve the project and shell
out to `srelay decisions` / `srelay unresolved`. DSH is a desktop GUI:

| signal | DSH desktop result |
|---|---|
| `process.cwd()` | the **installation directory**, not the project |
| `ctx.cmdlineArgs` | empty array (no argv for a GUI launch) |
| `AssembleContext` | `{ scope?, signal? }` only — no cwd, no project |

All three are dead ends, so this plugin resolves the project a different way
(see below) and registers a `systemPrompt.section()` provider — DSH's official
injection point — that renders the brief before each model step.

## What it does

1. **Brief injection.** A `systemPrompt` section, evaluated on every assembly
   (i.e. before each model step), showing the project's recent decisions and
   unresolved questions, with decisions dated `[MM-DD]`. Bounded to 1200 chars.
   The read path is **SQL-first** (`node:sqlite`, read-only) with the CLI as a
   fallback: cold path ~5 ms, warm path ~1 ms, versus ~310–360 ms for shelling
   out to the CLI. `SRELAY_BRIEF_FORCE_CLI=1` forces the old path for A/B
   comparison.
2. **Project resolution.** A fallback chain that needs no configuration in the
   common case (below).
3. **Auto-init.** Open a real folder in DSH and a memory library is created for
   it — no "please set this up" round trip. Temp directories, DSH's own
   installation, the npm global root and drive roots are excluded by a
   blacklist shared with the ZCode hook, so the rule lives in exactly one place.
   `init` is cheap (~190 ms, 166 KB) and reversible (delete `.sessionrelay/`).
4. **Seven native tools.** `srelay_search` / `srelay_show` / `srelay_record`
   for querying, `srelay_init` for creating a library, and
   `srelay_bind_project` / `srelay_confirm_bind_project` /
   `srelay_cancel_bind_project` for the two-stage binding.

## Project resolution

```
① agent.session.header.cwd      → DSH's own validated absolute cwd (per-agent)
② env SRELAY_PROJECT_ROOT       → if it points at a directory containing .sessionrelay
③ DSH session inference         → most recent session group under ~/.dsh/sessions
④ registry single survivor      → exactly one project registered and alive
⑤ dangling                      → do not guess; list candidates for the user
```

Step ① is the primary signal. DSH hands the plugin the working directory the
session was created in, so there is nothing to infer. Steps ③–⑤ are the
fallbacks, and step ③ is the interesting one.

DSH groups its own session storage by working directory slug:

```
~/.dsh/sessions/
  --E-music~0020player--      ← E:\music player
  --D-agent1super--           ← D:\agent1super
```

That slug is DSH's own record of which directory a session belongs to, so it is
the most reliable "which project am I in" signal available to a plugin. The
encoding (mirrored from `src/adapters/dsh/format.ts`) is:

| input | slug |
|---|---|
| `:` | *(dropped)* |
| `\` `/` | `-` |
| space | `~0020` |
| non-ASCII | `~` + 4 uppercase hex |

Because `-` is ambiguous (a real directory may contain a hyphen), decoding is
**not** a pure string operation. The plugin walks the segments depth-first and
prunes on real filesystem existence — only prefixes that actually exist are
explored. This recovers paths like `D:\agent1super\tmp\docx-build` correctly.

Step ⑤ deliberately refuses to guess. Injecting the wrong project's brief is
worse than injecting nothing: it would show project A's decisions inside a
project B conversation, and the model has no way to tell they are unrelated.

## Auto-init: what gets a library automatically

The rule is a **blacklist**, not a whitelist. Every real directory qualifies;
only directories that are never a project are excluded:

| Excluded | Why |
|---|---|
| `os.tmpdir()` and anything under it | scratch space; a stale registry of test sandboxes is exactly the mess this avoids |
| DSH's own installation and `~/.dsh` | the tool, not a project |
| the npm global root | same |
| drive roots (`D:\`) | a drive is not a project |

Consequences worth knowing: a `git clone` gets a library immediately; a folder
you just opened in a file manager gets one too; a monorepo subdirectory binds
at the repository root; a mis-created library self-heals because the global
registry prunes entries whose project has been dead for 30 days.

The ZCode hook (`~/.zcode/hooks/statebrief/brief.mjs`) applies the same
blacklist, so both clients behave identically. **When you change the rule,
change it in both places** — they are separate files by necessity (different
runtimes) but must not drift.

`srelay_init` exists as a tool so that "set this up" is something the model can
actually do rather than a sentence it can only promise. It is single-step, not
two-stage, because creating a library is reversible while *binding to* an
existing one is not.

## Two-stage binding

`srelay_bind_project` decides **which database decisions get written to**, so it
is not a decision the model may make on its own. If a model in a project B
session mis-resolved and bound itself to project A, every decision it then
recorded would be written into A's SQLite — irreversibly.

This mirrors SessionRelay's own rule that AI never gets delete tools; the same
constraint extends to "which store do writes go to":

- `srelay_bind_project({ projectPath })` — **proposes only**. Records a pending
  proposal and returns text explicitly asking the user to confirm.
- `srelay_confirm_bind_project()` — **applies**, and only after the user has
  said so.
- `srelay_cancel_bind_project()` — drops a pending proposal.

Proposals are tracked per scope, so multiple concurrent conversations do not
share binding state. A target path is only accepted if it already contains a
`.sessionrelay` database — otherwise binding a fresh directory would report
success and then fail silently on every subsequent call.

## Self-contained runtime (vendor/)

The plugin ships its own SessionRelay runtime under `vendor/` and prefers it
over any globally installed copy:

```
① SRELAY_CLI_PATH env   → development escape hatch (point at a working copy)
② vendor/ (bundled)     → default; works with no npm install and no network
③ global npm location   → fallback only
```

⚠️ **`vendor/` is a build artifact and is NOT in this git repository.** It is
~62 MB and carries `better-sqlite3` native bindings for every platform plus the
Chinese word-segmentation dictionaries, so committing it would permanently
bloat the history. Three ways to get it:

| 途径 | 命令 | 需要联网 | 适合 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Release asset** (easiest) | Download the `vendor-*.tar.gz` asset from [Releases](https://github.com/rui08984-dot/dsh-sessionrelay/releases) and extract it into this directory | No (one-time) | Anyone who just wants a working offline copy |
| 从 npm 拉取 | `node vendor-srelay.mjs` | 是 | 想要最新构建 |
| 从本地已装副本复制 | `node vendor-srelay.mjs --from <path>` | 否 | 本机已有 srelay |

**没有 vendor 时会发生什么**：插件不会报错，它会静默回落到全局 npm 安装的
srelay。如果那台机器上装的是**上游原版**（没有 DSH 采集源探测、没有本仓库的
修复），你会得到一个"看起来正常、简报却永远空"的半失效状态——这正是本项目花
了最多力气修的那类静默故障。所以要么装 vendor，要么确认全局那份是我们的版本。

验证 vendor 就位：

```sh
node -e "console.log(require('fs').existsSync('vendor/dist/srelay.js'))"   # 必须 true
```

## ⚠️ Prerequisite: the SessionRelay daemon must be running

This plugin **reads** the memory database; it does not collect anything by itself.
Collection is done by S

plugins.readme_text:
# 🛡️ dsh-permission-rules - **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: 电机电磁设计 AI 插件完整版（L0 毫秒级广筛 → L1 RMxprt + L2 Motor-CAD 校核）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-motor-ai

电机设计完整版插件（L1/L2），基于 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 框架。

## 架构

```
dsh-motor-ai-core      ← 共享核心（公式引擎、代理模型、经验回灌等）
├── dsh-motor-ai-l0    ← 免费版（L0 公式通道）
└── dsh-motor-ai       ← 完整版（L0 + L1 RMxprt + L2 Motor-CAD）
```

## 安装

**方式一：DSH 界面直装（不走市场）**

DSH Desktop →「添加和管理插件」→ 输入框填：

```
dsh-motor-ai@1.0.0-rc.7
```

> - **必须带 `@版本`**：安装器用 `spec.lastIndexOf('@')` 切分包名与版本，纯包名会把版本算错。
> - 也可填 GitHub 仓库地址（需仓库真实存在）或本地目录路径。
> - full 与 `dsh-motor-ai-l0` **互斥**，安装前请先在「已安装」里卸载 l0。
> - 本插件自带组合包配置（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml`），
>   这是 DSH 界面能识别并安装它的前提。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
# 完整版（需先卸载免费版，两者互斥）
npm uninstall dsh-motor-ai-l0
npm install dsh-motor-ai@next
```

> **当前版本口径**：`latest` = `1.0.0-beta`；`1.0.0-rc.7` 为预发布，走 `next` 标签。
> 稳定版发布后 `@next` 可省略。

## 配置

插件**自带**的默认配置在包内 `cordis.patch.yml`（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明）。
用户级覆盖写在 **profile 的** `cordis.patch.yml` 里，按 `id` 覆盖 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-motor-ai
  config:
    level: l2        # l0 / l1 / l2
    l1Enabled: true  # 启用 RMxprt 求解
    l2Enabled: false # Motor-CAD 暂不启用
```

> 无论 `level` 如何设置，**L0 永久免费可用**；L1/L2 工具恒注册，**调用时**按激活码门控。

## 工具

| 层级 | 工具 | 描述 | 状态 |
|------|------|------|------|
| L0 | motor_param_matrix | 参数矩阵生成 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_l0_estimate | 公式效率估算 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_design_validate | 设计校验 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_l0_pipeline | L0 全流程 | ✅ |
| L1 | motor_l1_estimate | RMxprt 估算 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L1 | motor_l1_pipeline | RMxprt 批处理 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L1 | motor_rmxprt_solve | RMxprt 单解 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L2 | motor_l2_validate | 几何校验 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 Motor-CAD |
| L2 | motor_motorcad_verify | COM 验证 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 Motor-CAD |
| 通用 | motor_env_check | L1/L2 环境一键体检 + 修复引导 | ✅ 免费、不占配额 |

> **求解器依赖说明（rc.11 起）**：L1/L2 的求解器脚本已随包分发（`scripts/_rmxprt_venv_worker.py` / `scripts/motorcad_bridge.py`），装完即可用；但**本机仍需安装对应商业求解器**：
> - **L1**：Ansys AEDT 2020.x（RMxprt）+ Python 3.10 环境装有 `pyaedt 0.6.x` 或 `pywin32`；解释器路径用 `PYTHON_BIN` 指定，worker 可用 `RMXPRT_WORKER_PATH` 覆盖（默认用包内副本）
> - **L2**：Motor-CAD v11.1.5（`MotorCAD.AppAutomation`）+ Python 3.10 环境装有 `pywin32`；路径用 `MOTORCAD_PATH` / `MOTORCAD_INSTALL_DIR` 指定
> 未装求解器时调用返回结构化错误引导，不影响 L0。
>
> **环境自动搜寻与引导（rc.12 起）**：授权通过后，L1/L2 真解算前会自动体检五项环境（Python / pyaedt / pywin32 / AEDT / Motor-CAD）——缺失项直接返回人话修复指引（下载页 / pip 命令 / 环境变量 / 配置键），**不会白耗 60-120s 的 AEDT/COM 启动，也不扣当日配额**。任何时候都可用 `motor_env_check` 一键体检（免费、不占配额）。

## 互斥规则

- 完整版与免费版**不能同时安装**
- 升级时需先 `npm uninstall dsh-motor-ai-l0`

## 开发

```bash
# 运行验证
npm run verify

# 运行测试
npm test

## 激活（L1/L2 解锁）

`dsh-motor-ai` 按 **PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0** 分发：非商业免费装；商业使用需激活码（收费墙是许可约束，不是代码锁）。

### 分层与状态

| 层 | 工具 | 状态 |
|----|------|------|
| L0 | `motor_param_matrix` / `motor_l0_estimate` / `motor_design_validate` / `motor_l0_pipeline` | ✅ 免费即用 |
| L1 | `motor_l1_estimate` / `motor_l1_pipeline` / `motor_rmxprt_solve` | 🔒 需激活 |
| L2 | `motor_l2_validate` / `motor_motorcad_verify` | 🔒 需激活 |

### 分级启用

在 `cordis.patch.yml`（DSH profile）中：

```yaml
plugins:
  dsh-motor-ai:
    level: l1          # l0 / l1 / l2
    l1Enabled: true    # 启用 RMxprt 求解
    l2Enabled: false   # Motor-CAD 暂不启用
```

默认 `level: l0`，仅 L0 免费工具可用。

### 激活流程

1. 向作者获取激活码（私域渠道，形如 `v2:full:wangxue98:<buyer_b64>:<ts>:<exp>:<sig128>`）
2. 在 DSH 对话中运行命令：`/dsh-motor-ai-activate <code>`
3. 回显 `✅ 激活成功！当前层级: FULL`，`motor_l1_*` / `motor_l2_*` 即解锁
4. 激活状态落盘 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-motor-ai/activation.json`
5. 未激活时调 L1/L2：返回 `LICENSE_REQUIRED` 结构化引导（含联系邮箱，不会崩，L0 照常可用）

### 作者自测签码（非对称 Ed25519）

激活码用 **Ed25519 非对称签名**：公钥随包发布，私钥作者自持。

```bash
# 1) 生成密钥对：公钥写 lib/activation-public.pem（随包），私钥写 .secrets/activation-private.pem（绝不入库/不随包）
node scripts/mint-activation-code.mjs --genkey --write-secret

# 2) 签发 full 测试码（私钥来源：--key > ACTIVATION_PRIVATE_KEY 环境变量 > .secrets/activation-private.pem）

# 输出形如 v2:full:wangxue98:<b64>:<ts>:<exp>:<128hex-sig>
```

把上一步的码在 DSH 对话里 `/dsh-motor-ai-activate <code>` 即可解锁。

### 非对称验签机制

- **v2（默认）**：Ed25519。发布包内置公钥（`lib/license.mjs` 常量 + `lib/activation-public.pem`），部署出去即可验签，**外部买家可被真实放行**；私钥仅作者持有，用于签码。
- **密钥隔离**：私钥在 `.secrets/`（`.gitignore` 排除，且不在 `package.json` 的 `files` 白名单），**不会进入 npm 发布包**；公钥公开，随包无泄露风险。
- **v1（兼容）**：旧的 HMAC 对称码（`ACTIVATION_HMAC_KEY`）仍可验，但已废弃，新签码一律 v2。

### 端到端自检

```bash

```

## 商业授权

本插件按 **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0** 许可分发：个人及非商业用途可免费使用；商业用途需获取商业授权。

- 激活码**只锁 L1/L2，绝不锁 L0**；无码、码过期或码无效时，插件照常加载、L0 全部可用，仅在调用 L1/L2 时返回引导。

商业授权报价与采购，请联系：**13546196530@163.com**
