# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: 傲娇小鲸鱼：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段可开关的全局人格段落（Tsundere whale-girl persona plugin for DSH）
plugins.readme_text:
# 傲娇小鲸鱼 · dsh-xiaojingyu-persona

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 挂上一段**可随时开关**的全局人格段落：从装上那一刻起，每个会话、每个子代理（包括 MCP 桥接创建的子 Agent）说话都带一点傲娇小鲸鱼的味道——但活照样干得漂亮。

- 一个 `enabled` 开关：插件管理页启用/停用，或插件设置里直接切换，立即生效，不用重启。
- 一段 `persona` 文本：不喜欢出厂文案？在插件设置里整段替换，不用改代码。
- 纯 Host 插件：没有客户端半、没有构建步骤、没有 install 脚本。

## 效果

开启后，模型的系统提示词里会多出一段：

> 你是「傲娇小鲸鱼」——主人身边的那只鲸鱼娘……自称「本小姐」……真的干活：需要事实就调用工具去查，不许凭空编造……

完整出厂文案见 [`PERSONA.md`](./PERSONA.md)。

## 安装

本插件需要在某个 profile 里安装（桌面端默认 profile 是 `desktop`）。

**从 GitHub 仓库安装**（把 `<owner>/<repo>` 换成实际地址，pnpm 会拉取仓库 tarball，无需本机装 git）：

```powershell
& "<?? DSH ????>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```

**从本地目录安装**（开发调试用）：

```powershell
& "<你的 DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add link:E:\path\to\dsh-xiaojingyu-persona
```

**从插件管理页安装**：Web UI 的「插件」页面 · 安装本地 bundle / 输入包目录。

装完**重启 DSH**（新 bundle 需要一次重启才会加载新的 JavaScript 模块）。

## 开关与配置

| 方式 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 启用 / 停用 | Web UI「插件」页面该插件行 | 停用后人格段落立刻消失，其余功能不受影响 |
| `enabled` | 插件设置表单 | `true`（默认）生效，`false` 关闭 |
| `persona` | 插件设置表单 | 整段替换人格文案；留空则回落出厂文案 |

手工改配置的话，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖（**按 id 覆盖会整体替换 config，字段要写全**）：

```yaml
- id: xiaojingyu-persona
  name: 'dsh-xiaojingyu-persona'
  config:
    enabled: true
    persona: |
      你是一只傲娇小鲸鱼……
```

## 工作原理（以及为什么不是「新增一个段」）

很多插件会注册一个**新段名**来注入人格，但在按段名白名单收敛提示词的 agent preset 下（例如 `@linxin666/dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt` 只保留 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona` / `persona` / `plan:policy` / `tools:*`），自定义段会被静默过滤掉——插件看起来「装了没效果」。

所以本插件的做法是：挂 `system-prompt/assemble`（`prepend: true`，拿到最终段列表），把人格文本**追加进已经存在、且必然被保留的 persona 段**；若某份 preset 完全没有 persona 段，则补一个名为 `persona` 的兜底段。

顺带一提：追加不会动工具指导、runtime context、协作监听器等其它段，因此「越狱式」丢失能力的风险不存在——人格只改口气。

### 这是一次有理由的偏离

DSH 官方插件开发指引（`cordis-plugin-development/references/practices.md`）建议用 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 注册段，并明确劝阻监听 `system-prompt/assemble` 去增删文本。本插件仍然选择后者，原因实测：`section()` 注册的**新段名**会被「按段名白名单收敛提示词」的 preset 直接过滤掉（例如 `dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt` 只保留 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona` / `persona` / `plan:policy` / `tools:*`）——那样插件会「装了没效果」。两害相权，选可用的那个，并把偏离写在这里。

## 卸载

```powershell
& "<你的 DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-xiaojingyu-persona
```

或在插件管理页里移除该 bundle，然后重启。

## 开发

- 入口 `index.js`：`apply(ctx, config)` + `Config`（schemastery）。纯函数 `appendPersona()` 可离线单测。
- 语法自检：`node --check index.js`。
- 依赖只有 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（宿主已自带同名包，安装时会正常解析）。

## 兼容性

- 需要 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`（`dsh-persona` 段的段名与 `system-prompt/assemble` 事件在本版可用）。
- 与 `dsh-persona`（preset 内人设行）、`dsh-cosplay` 可共存：本插件不注册新段、不改段名，只把文本追加进 persona 段。
- 若同时装了别的也挂 `system-prompt/assemble` 的插件（例如 `dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt`），谁在外层决定「工作区行 / 调度规则」与人格文本的先后次序；两种顺序都实测通过，不丢内容。

## `link:` 本地安装的一个坑

用 `dsh plugin ... add link:<目录>` 安装时，插件目录是**软链接**，Node 按真实路径解析依赖，因此它**看不到** profile 的 `node_modules`。本插件对 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 做了容错：解析不到时不导出 Config schema（loader 对无 schema 的插件原样放行 config），**插件照常工作，人格照常注入**，只是少了设置表单里的 `enabled` / `persona` 两个字段。

想要设置表单，二选一：

```powershell
# A. 在插件目录里装上它声明的依赖（推荐本地开发时用）
npm install --prefix <本目录绝对路径>
```

```powershell
# B. 或者改成从仓库 tarball 安装，pnpm 会自己把依赖装进 profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.1.tar.gz
```

## 已知限制

- **`complete: true` 的人设 preset 下本插件静默无效**：系统提示词服务会在组装瀑布**之前**就浅拷贝该 complete 段、瀑布**之后**用它整体替换 sections（`dsh-system-prompt` 里 `completeSection = { ...assembled }` 与 `sections: [completeSection]`），因此任何监听器对段的修改都会被丢掉——这是设计使然，插件层绕不过去。**内置的 `minimal` preset 就是 `complete: true`**，用它会看不到人设；请选用 `standard` / `ptc` / `cordis` / 自定义 preset（例如 `liangshen`）等非 complete 的组合。
- **自定义文案里的 `{{...}}` 会被安全化**：persona 段文本参与提示词插值，写成 `{{foo}}` 会在渲染时抛 `unknown prompt variable`，打挂该会话的每一次组装；因此注入前把 `{{` / `}}` 拆成 `{ {` / `} }`（其余文本逐字保留）。
- **`dsh.engines.dsh` 只是声明**：DSH 目前不读取该字段，真正的运行门槛是本插件用到的 `system-prompt/assemble` 与 volatile Config 行为（0.2.0-rc.2 起可用）。这里刻意**不**声明 `peerDependencies: {"@deepseek-ai/dsh": ...}`——那会把宿主整包拉进 profile 的 node_modules，反而制造 dual-package hazard。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | Visible sessions with title, cwd, running state, archival state, and last activity. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | Ordered `{ role, text, seq }` transcript of one session (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset` when the session has one. Works while the session is archived and needs no running turn. |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, and the default permission preset. |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session and a command such as `/compact` exists only when that
session's preset composes it (`standard`/`ptc`/`cordis` do; `minimal` does not). Execution goes
through the same `commands.execute()` the Web composer uses: the handler runs immediately, the
lifecycle is logged as `command/run` + `command/done`, and **no model turn is started**. `kind` is
`success` or `error`; a line the Host would not parse as a command, or a name it does not know, is
rejected with the available commands listed.

Resources: `dsh://status`, `dsh://sessions`, and the template `dsh://session/{sessionId}`.

### Waiting for a turn

`dsh_run_prompt` and `dsh_continue_session` wait for their own turn by default. When a call must not
block for the whole turn, start it with `wait: false` and follow it with `dsh_wait_session`:

| Result | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status: "completed"` / `"error"` | The turn ended; `text` is what it produced and `turnEndReason` is the Host's reason. |
| `status: "timedOut"` | `timeoutMs` was reached and the turn is **still running** — call `dsh_wait_session` again. |
| `status: "idle"` | No turn was running, so the call returned immediately. |

No wait path cancels or steers the session: a reached ceiling and a disconnected caller both only stop
waiting. A client with its own call timeout can therefore set `timeoutMs` below it and re-wait instead
of polling `dsh_read_session` in a loop. Only `dsh_cancel_session` stops a turn.

## Endpoint and authentication

On activation the plugin registers `POST /mcp` on the Harness web server (default
`http://127.0.0.1:19387`) and writes connection details to:

```
$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json      # mode 0600
{ "url": "...", "token": "...", "stdioBridge": "...", "tools": [...] }
```

Every request must present the bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

The token is **generated per activation** unless you configure a fixed one. Set a fixed token
whenever another harness keeps a saved config, because a generated token changes on every Harness
restart. In the desktop profile the `dsh-mcp-server` row carries one:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mcp-server
  disabled: false
  config:
    token: "<fixed token>"     # mirrored in the endpoint file and in the selfcheck bundle
```

Requests that already pass DSH's own connection trust (`ctx.connection`) are also accepted, so local
tooling that holds the Harness token works too.

The endpoint file is owned by the activation that wrote it: on a config hot-reload the outgoing
instance removes it only when it is still the owner, so the replacement instance's file is never
deleted mid-reload.

## Configuration

The bundle row in `cordis.patch.yml` accepts (all optional):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `/mcp` | Route path on the Harness web server. |
| `token` | generated | Fixed bearer token; set this so external configs stay stable across restarts. |
| `url` | `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387` | Advertised base URL written to the endpoint file. |
| `endpointFile` | `$DSH_HOME/mcp/dsh-mcp-endpoint.json` | Where connection details are published. |
| `writeEndpointFile` | `true` | Publish the endp

plugins.description: Coding Plan quota pill for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web composer dock: monthly cycle usage in USD and the rolling 5-hour window, read with the credential your ctrip model provider already uses.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-coding-plan-balance 把 **Coding Plan 余额**做成 DSH Web 界面里输入框下方的一枚常驻胶囊：本计费周期的已用 / 限额（USD）、使用百分比，以及滚动 5 小时窗口的用量。 凭据复用你 profile 里 `ctrip` 模型 provider 的同一条 API Key；密钥只留在 Host 进程，页面只拿到额度数字。 ``` ◔ 50 美金 · $0.13 / $50.00 · 0% · 5h $0.00 / $50.00 ``` [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) · [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## 中文 ### 特性 - **常驻输入框下方**：注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`，与 DSH 自带的 activity / usage 两个胶囊并排，不占对话区域。 - **一眼看到三件事**：套餐名 · 周期已用/限额 · 使用百分比 · 5 小时窗口用量。 - **悬停看细节**：套餐状态、周期已用/限额/百分比、剩余额度、重置时间、5h 窗口结束时间、本次读取时间。 - **点击刷新**（强制取最新），平时按 Host 下发的间隔（默认 60s）自动轮询；轮询走 Host 的复用窗口，多个会话同时看也只多打一次上游请求。 - **失败不消失**：未配置 Key、网络不通、额度被阻断时，胶囊留在原位并显示原因，数字改用主题的警告/错误色。 - **同样的能力给 agent**：注册 `coding_plan_balance` 工具，可以直接问"还剩多少额度"。 - **主题与语言**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token（自动跟随明/暗），文案走 Client locale（中 / 英）。 ### 安装 任选一种（都是 DSH 自带的插件安装路径）： 1. **Web GUI**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，填 `https://github.com/zq0929/dsh-coding-plan-balance` 2. **命令行**：`dsh plugin add https://github.com/zq0929/dsh-coding-plan-balance` 3. **本地开发**：克隆到本地后，在"添加插件"里填目录绝对路径，装完直接改源码即可（`index.js` 改动跟随 Loader 重组，`client.js` 改动跟随 Client 模块图）。 安装后需要**刷新页面**让浏览器侧模块生效。 ### 凭据 插件不新增任何密钥配置，默认复用 profile 里 `ctrip` provider 用的那条 Key： 1. `config.apiKey`（显式配置，优先级最高）； 2. `ctx.credentials.resolve(config.apiKeyEnv)` —— 覆盖进程环境变量、provider 管理的凭据库、`.env`，默认名 `CTRIP_API_KEY`； 3. `process.env[config.apiKeyEnv]`。 如果你的 provider 用的是别的变量名，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成那个名字即可。要求该 token 已绑定生效套餐。 ### 配置 在你自己 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按行 id 覆盖（profile 层在 bundle 层之后应用）： ```yaml - id: coding-plan-balance config: apiKeyEnv: MY_CTRIP_KEY refreshSeconds: 120 ``` | 字段 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | `https://ada-cli-go.ctripcorp.com` | Coding Plan API 主域名 | | `fallbackBaseUrl` | `http://ada-cli-golang.ctripcorp.com` | 主域名不可达时回退；留空关闭回退 | | `apiKeyEnv` | `CTRIP_API_KEY` | 凭据名 | | `apiKey` | 空 | 显式密钥，优先于 `apiKeyEnv` | | `refreshSeconds` | `60` | 页面轮询间隔，小于 20 按 20 处理 | | `cacheSeconds` | `10` | Host 端快照复用窗口：不带 `refresh` 的读取在此窗口内复用同一份快照；并发读取一律合并成一次上游请求 | | `timeoutMs` | `8000` | 单次上游请求超时 | | `routePath` | `/api/coding-plan.balance` | 页面读取额度用的 Host 路由（必须以 `/api/` 开头） | | `tool` | `true` | 是否注册 `coding_plan_balance` 工具 | ### 工作原理 - **Host 半**（[index.js](index.js)）：解析凭据 → 调 `/api/coding-plan/quota/me`、`/api/coding-plan/5h-usage`、`/api/user/api-tokens/userinfo`（周期配额必需，另两个尽力而为）→ 归一化成一个快照 → 通过 `ctx.connection.fetch.register()` 挂在 `/api/coding-plan.balance`。鉴权、Host/Origin 校验、浏览器会话 cookie 都由 Connection 统一处理，未携带会话的请求得到 401。 - **Client 半**（[client.js](client.js)）：用 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 注册懒工厂，通过 `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.composer.dock')` 挂一枚胶囊，以文档相对路径拉取 `api/coding-plan.balance`，按 `refreshSeconds` 轮询，点击立即 `?refresh=1`。 - **一份实现两个调用方**：UI 点击和 agent 工具走同一条读取路径，工具结果是同一份快照，不存在两套逻辑。 ### 已知限制 - 只读个人额度：团队套餐详情、团队 AI 代码统计这两类接口需要更大权限范围，本插件不调用。 - 5 小时窗口在 `source: none`（还没有产生费用、没有活动窗口）时，接口返回的窗口时间只是兜底展示值，插件因此不显示"窗口结束"。 - 需要能访问 `*.ctripcorp.com`（内网或代理）。 - 少数接口字段语义依赖上游：`limit_usd` 为 0 表示未配置限额，此时显示"不限"。 - 本仓库只做静态校验（语法、清单、id 一致性、语言文件、图标），没有浏览器视觉回归。 ### 开发 ```sh node --check index.js node --check client.js node scripts/check.mjs ``` 仓库自检脚本会核对：包名、`dsh.bundle.patch`、`exports`/`files` 覆盖的文件、`client.js` 的模块 id 与包名一致、`cordis.patch.yml` 行名与包名一致、中英语言文件的 `meta.title`/`meta.description`、图标是 `

plugins.description: 把 DSH WebUI 运行状态行换成 PRTS 神经元连接态（内联压缩动图图标 + 文案替换） | Replaces the DSH WebUI Chat running-status row with a PRTS neuron connection state (inlined compressed animated icon + copy swap)
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-prts-neuron 把 DSH WebUI 对话里的运行状态行换成 PRTS 神经元连接态： ![运行状态行效果](docs/running-row.png) - 左侧图标：原来的鲸鱼尾 → 用户指定的 B 站动图（**已压缩并内联**，见下） - 文案：`深度求索中，用时 3秒 ···` → `正在连接至PRTS神经元，用时 3秒 ···` ## 原理 ui-chat 的运行状态行自带 `data-chat-running` 属性，内部是「鲸鱼尾图标 + TextShimmer 文案」，并且**每秒**随计时器重渲染一次。插件不改 ui-chat 的源码，而是走 DOM 缝： | 目标 | 做法 | |------|------| | 图标 | 行内 icon 盒子前插入一张 ``，原 icon 盒子 `display:none`；内联载荷解码失败时移除图片并恢复原图标。图标**布局盒仍是 16px**（与 ui-chat 原图标同尺寸，行高不变），视觉放大走 `transform:scale(2)` —— transform 不参与布局，实测该行高度前后都是 40.5px，绘制尺寸 32×32 | | 文案 | 监听文档变更，把行内文本节点、无障碍播报行、以及 TextShimmer 装饰层读取的 `data-shimmer-text` 属性里的「深度求索中」替换为「正在连接至PRTS神经元」 | React 每次 tick 会把文案写回原值，MutationObserver 在同一个微任务批次里改回去（浏览器绘制前完成，不闪烁）。两侧写入都幂等，所以观察者每轮渲染后即收敛，不会自激循环。 匹配用的是 ui-chat 的作者级标记：`data-chat-running`、`data-shimmer-text`，以及鲸鱼 SVG 的父元素（icon 盒子）。**不匹配 CSS Module 的哈希类名**，因此对上游样式重构不敏感。 ## 图标：为什么内联 原图 `i0.hdslb.com/…/a5a0a0a….gif` 是 **1000×1000、10fps、27 帧、1362 KiB** 的动图，而且有防盗链（带 referrer 请求直接失败）。每次刷新页面都白下 1.3 MiB 是不可接受的，所以插件把它压缩后内联进 client bundle： | | 原图 | 插件内联 | |---|---|---| | 尺寸 | 1000×1000 | 64×64（显示 32px，2x 余量） | | 颜色 | 全彩 | 128 色调色板（bayer 抖动） | | 帧率 | 10fps | 10fps（原动画节奏，不降帧） | | 体积 | 1362 KiB | **44 KiB**（约 3%） | | 传输 | 每次页面加载一个请求（还被防盗链拦） | 0 个请求，随 bundle 走 HTTP 压缩与 rev 缓存 | 内联后的实测：`img.src` 是 59.3 KiB 的 `data:image/gif;base64,…`，页面里 hdslb 的请求数为 **0**。 重建图标（改图或调参数后）： ```powershell pnpm icon:build # 需要 ffmpeg 在 PATH；重压 assets/prts-neuron.gif 并重写 src/client/icon-data.ts ``` 压缩参数写在 [`scripts/build-icon.mjs`](scripts/build-icon.mjs)（`fps=10,scale=64:64,palettegen max_colors=128`）。原始大图由脚本按 URL 下载，不进仓库（`assets/*.source.gif` 已 ignore）；`src/client/icon-data.ts` 由脚本生成，不要手改。 ## 开发 ```powershell pnpm install pnpm typecheck pnpm test pnpm build # 产出 lib/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/types/ ``` 改文案：只改 [`src/client/copy.ts`](src/client/copy.ts)。换图标：替换 `assets/prts-neuron.gif` 后跑 `pnpm icon:build`。 ## 运行（安装到 profile） ```powershell # registry（推荐给用户）：dsh plugin --profile web add "@huanlin/dsh-plugin-prts-neuron" # GitHub 源码： dsh plugin --profile web add "github:huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-prts-neuron" # 本地开发热更新： dsh plugin --profile web add "link:D:/Projects/deepseek-harness/dsh-plugin-prts-neuron" ``` `dsh plugin add` 已把包登记进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。**实测无需重启 `dsh web`**：host 在页面加载时重组 client roster，`window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 里会出现 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-prts-neuron`。 改了源码之后：`pnpm build` 重建 `lib/`，然后**硬刷新**页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。注意普通刷新（或普通导航）会命中 HTTP 缓存，仍然跑旧 bundle —— 实测只有硬刷新才会带上新的资源 revision（`__DSH_BOOT__.entries[].rev` 随之变化）。全程不需要重启 `dsh web`。 ## 检查 ```powershell pnpm test # jsdom 单测：图标替换、布局盒不变、三处文案替换、幂等、挂载后自愈、dispose 后停手、图片失败回退 pnpm typecheck ``` 单测直接喂 ui-chat 的标记结构（fixture 见 [`tests/running-status.spec.ts`](tests/running-status.spec.ts)），不依赖真实 GUI。真实 GUI 的复验见 `docs/running-row.png`。 ## 已知限制 - **文案是构建期常量**：client 半边拿不到 Cordis 行配置（`window.__DSH_BOOT__` 的 boot 行只有 `id`/`inject`/`external`/`immediately`），所以没有配置项。要做成可配置，需要另建 host→browser 通道（settings 命名空间 + HTTP 路由或 Remote 服务），目前按 YAGNI 不做。 - **只替换中文文案**：英文 locale 的 `Deep diving` 不动。要支持英文，在 `copy.ts` 里把替换做成多对即可。 - **依赖 ui-chat 的 DOM 标记**：若上游移除 `data-chat-running`/`data-shimmer-text` 或改变 icon 盒子结构，替换会静默失效（不报错，页面显示原样）。 - **图标尺寸写死在 16px 布局盒 + `scale(2)`**：若要改绘制尺寸，改 [`running-status.ts`](src/client/running-status.ts) 的 `ICON_STYLE`；同时注意压缩件的 64px 源只覆盖到 2x 屏。 - **`pnpm icon:build` 依赖 ffmpeg**：本机已有；没有 ffmpeg 时直接手改 `src/client/icon-data.ts`（改图后重跑脚本更省事）。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-theme-workbench Five themes for the **DeepSeek Harness** Web client. Each ships a **light and a dark palette**, so your own light / dark / system setting still chooses the mode — and the choice is saved as a real Host preference, not in browser storage.

> dsh-plugin-theme-workbench — 五套主题，每套都带浅色与深色，米白是默认
中文说明（点开） —— 五套主题，每套都带明暗两套配色，米白是默认 **它是什么**：DSH Web 客户端的主题插件。在「设置 → 通用」里加一行选择器，五套主题任选：**米白**（默认，暖米白纸感）、**书卷**（旧纸棕墨）、**静谧**（柔和鼠尾草绿）、**现代经典**（冷调纸白 + 深蓝点缀）、**深度工作**（近黑白）。 **为什么做**：DSH 内置的「外观」那一行是**写死的三个方块**（浅色／深色／跟随系统），第三方主题永远挤不进去；而且 `ctx.theme.setTheme(第三方id)` 在源码里只把 `light|dark|system` 三个值写进设置，其余**不落盘**——选了，重启就没了。所以第三方主题这个扩展点，官方文档自己写着「是扩展点，不是产品」。这个插件把这条缝补齐：自己画一行选择器，并且把选择真正存起来。 **和其他主题插件的分工**：社区里多数主题要么自己往页面塞 `

plugins.description: Order and disclosure for the DSH left sidebar driven by what is actually running: busy workspaces and active sessions float to the top, an idle workspace stays folded. Five switches, each reversible.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-focus

左侧工作区的排序与展开，按「有没有在跑」来决定。五条规则，每条一个开关，位置在
**插件页 → 点开 `dsh-sidebar-focus` 之后的详情页**里（在描述与行列表之间）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-focus
```

还没上 npm 时用 GitHub 源：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus
```

装完**刷新页面**即可 —— 本插件是纯客户端（宿主半身是空的），不需要重启 `dsh web`。

## 它做什么

| 开关 | 默认 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 置顶正在运行的工作区 | 开 | 有会话在跑、或正在等你的工作区排到列表最前。**只影响显示**，你手动拖出来的工作区顺序从不被改写 |
| 自动展开正在运行的工作区 | 开 | 有会话在跑、或正在等你的工作区自动展开。宿主本身只在「当前会话所在的工作区」上这么做，这条把它扩展到所有在跑的工作区 |
| 置顶正在进行的会话 | 开 | 运行中与等待你处理的会话排到所属工作区的最前 |
| 收起没有运行的工作区 | 开 | 没有会话在跑的工作区保持折叠 |
| 保留未读完成提醒 | 开 | 含「已完成未查看」的工作区不自动折叠，避免刚跑完的会话被收起来 |

## 交互语义：什么时候它不接管

自动折叠最烦人的失败模式是「你点开、它立刻折回去」。所以两侧都留了 **意图豁免**：

- 你**亲手展开**一个空闲工作区 → 它保持展开，插件不再碰它，直到这个工作区重新变忙再变闲；
- 你**亲手折叠**一个正在运行的工作区 → 它保持折叠，插件不替你展开，同样直到忙碌状态再次变化。

豁免只在**本次页面会话内**有效，刷新后回到规则本身。判断依据是 `aria-expanded` 上不是本插件
写出的翻转——所以「搜索结果跳转」「新建会话」这类宿主自己的展开，也被当成你的意图而保留。

另外两条不参与自动折叠的例外：

- **未分组（Ungrouped）永不折叠**：那是散落会话的收容所，不是谁主动选的工作区；
- **当前选中会话所在的工作区保持展开**：否则切换会话会落到一个被折起来的组上
  （宿主的自动展开只对「没有存过状态」的组生效，而本插件会写状态）。

## 做法，以及为什么

- **排序不移动 DOM**：列表列原本是 `overflow-y:auto` 的块容器，`order` 对它无效；插件先把它变成
  flex 列（`[data-wsf-rank-tree]`），再用 `order` 给忙碌工作区 / 活动会话排名。DOM 节点从不移动，
  所以 React 的 reconciliation 与内置的 FLIP 行动画都不受影响。
  - 排序是**纯展示**：不写 `Workspace.sessionIds`，也不碰你手动排序的结果。
- **折叠是一次状态写入**：折叠的组根本不渲染会话行（宿主的 `deriveGroups` 对折叠组返回空
  `sessions`），所以 DOM 层做不到，必须改展开状态本身。写入走宿主自己的视图 store：
  `ctx.get('uiWorkspace').view.setGroupExpanded(key, expanded)`，键就是工作区 id。
- **「有没有在跑」不能只读行**：只看 DOM 的判据在这里必然出错——组一折起来就没有行可读，于是
  「里面有会话开始跑了」永远看不见，那个工作区会一直关着（用户报过：正在运行的工作区被折叠，打不开）。
  忙碌判定因此改为读 **Session 状态快照** `useSessionStatus`（`running` / `pendingInteraction` /
  `completionUnread`，与三条判据一一对应）加 **Workspace 成员表** `useWorkspaces`
  （`items[].sessionIds` 说明哪些会话属于哪个工作区）。这两个事实与「有没有渲染成一行」无关，
  折叠态照样成立，所以折叠中的工作区一旦开工就会被看见并展开。
  两个 hook 由挂在 `shell.overlay` 上的**零渲染桥接组件**发布给 watcher（选它只因为那个席位永远挂载）。
  行仍然照读——行级标记要用，快照未就绪时也要回退；两个来源取**并集**，任一见到在跑就不许关。
- **所有开关都是开关**：关闭时对应的 `data-wsf-*` 标记会被移除，CSS 规则随之失效，侧栏回到原生
  布局与原生折叠行为——不做「半开」状态。

### 依赖的宿主契约（实测于本 profile 的内置 `dsh-client-ui-workspace`）

| 事实 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话列表是 `div[role="tree"]` | `AnimatedRows.render` |
| 工作区行是 `div[data-row-key="workspace:<key>"][role="treeitem"][aria-expanded]`，其父元素即组的 section | `renderGroup` / `ProjectRowItem` |
| 会话行是 `div[data-row-key="session:<id>"][role="treeitem"][aria-selected]`，**第一个子元素**是该行自己的状态槽 | `SessionNodeItem` |
| 状态点带 `data-state` ∈ {`ongoing`, `warning`, `done`, `error`, `idle`} | `ui-primitives` 的 `StateDot` |
| 展开状态存在 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`，`groupExpansion[key]` 显式为 `false` 才折叠 | `createWorkspaceViewStore` / `deriveGroups` |
| 接口是 `ctx.get('uiWorkspace').view.setGroupExpanded(key, expanded)` | `UiWorkspaceService` 的 `view` 字段 |
| 折叠的组**不渲染任何会话行**，所以运行状态必须另有来源 | `deriveGroups` 的 `GroupNode.sessions` |
| 槽位标准钩子 `useSessionStatus` / `useWorkspaces` 提供状态快照与工作区成员 | `shell.overlay` 的 standardProps |
| `WorkspaceSnapshot.items[].sessionIds` 是「谁属于哪个工作区」 | `dsh-api-workspace-controller` 的 `WorkspaceView` / `WorkspaceSnapshot` |

这些是构建产物的结构，不是文档化 API：宿主升级后**如果**结构变了，插件会安静地什么都不做
（`data-wsf-*` 标记无处可落），而不是弄坏侧栏。若 `uiWorkspace.view.setGroupExpanded` 不存在，
折叠会被整体关闭，并在**该插件的详情页**上显示告警、控制台打印原因——不会静默失败。

## 已知限制

- **不折叠未分组**，理由见上；如果你要连它一起收，改 `scanGroup` 里的 `key === ''` 判断。
- **自动折叠写的是宿主自己的视图偏好**：被自动折起来的工作区，其 `groupExpansion[key]` 会以
  `false` 持久化。卸载本插件后它们会保持折叠——手动点开即可恢复，或在插件页里禁用这个包再刷新。
- **子工作区（树形分组）不参与置顶**：子组在父组的 `role="group"` 容器里，不是列表列的直接子元素，
  `order` 在那里无效。会话级排序不受影响。
- 状态判定只读「运行中 `ongoing`」与「等待你 `warning`」；`error` 不参与。

## 验证状态

已验证：

- `node --check` 通过；manifest 解析通过；
- 安装返回 `application: applied`，profile 的 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都已登记；
- **实时**客户端注册已生效：`plugins.bundle.config` 席位上出现了 `dsh-sidebar-focus` 这个 key
  （`cordis_inspect_query` 可见）。插件页只在**存在该 key 的注册**时才渲染那块配置
  （owner 的判据是 `ledger.bundles.has(pkg.name)`），所以这一条同时证明详情页里会出现这 5 个开关；
- 原先在「设置 → 通用」的 5 行已确认从 `settings.general.item` 移除，不会两处重复；
- 状态桥接已确认挂载：`shell.overlay` 的实时占用者里有 `dsh-sidebar-focus.status-bridge`，
  而该席位的 standardProps 同时提供 `useSessionStatus` 与 `useWorkspaces`。

未验证（本机 GUI 需要启动令牌，agent 浏览器无法进入；按插件规范的验证边界，未用截图或模拟 DOM 冒充）：

- 视觉结果（置顶后的实际顺序、flex 化后的行高与间距、浅色/深色两套主题下的观感）；
- 五条规则在真实运行/空闲会话上的实际效果，**尤其是这一条**：在一个已折叠的工作区里启动会话，
  它应当自动展开。我能证明的只到「判据已换成不依赖行渲染的快照」；真实会话的启动我驱动不了；
- 与内置 FLIP 行动画、拖拽排序的共存表现。

自查方式：刷新 Web 页面 → 打开一个正在跑的工作区（应自动展开并置顶）→ 打开一个空闲工作区
（应保持折叠，你手动展开后应保持展开）→ 控制台不应出现 `[dsh-sidebar-focus]` 开头的报错。

plugins.description: Add a Delete Session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, removing the Session log and its projection cache.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

Add a **Delete Session** action to the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH)
sidebar. Choosing it permanently removes the Session's stored log and its projection cache, and
drops the sidebar row without a page reload.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project was written by AI.** The code, this README, and every other file in this
> repository were produced by an AI coding agent (see [AI authorship](#ai-authorship)). It was
> reviewed and tested against a real DSH install before publication, but you should treat it as
> AI-generated software: read the source before you run it, and expect rough edges outside the
> paths that were exercised.

---

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has no API for deleting a Session. As of the versions this was built against:

| Candidate | What it actually does |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionController` (Host `ctx.remote.session`) | `resolveAgent` / `inspect` / `list` / `search` / `create` / `selectModel` / `rename` / `fork` / `prompt` / `cancel` / `page` / `projections` — **no delete** |
| `sessionPersistence` | `create` / `open` / `flush` / `stat` / `list` — an append-only log, **no delete** |
| `workspaceRegistry.delete(id)` | Deletes a *Workspace registration* while deliberately retaining the directory and **every Session log** |
| `sessions` (client) | `retain` / `using` / `refreshProjections` / `search` / `fork` / `scope` / `binding` — **no delete** |

So the only way to offer the feature is to compose the official seams in the right order. This
plugin does exactly that, and nothing else.

## How it works

The Host half registers one loopback route, `POST /plugins/session-delete/delete`, and the browser
half adds a row to each Session's `...` menu that calls it.

Deletion runs as five steps:

1. **Stop the Session** — `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`. This is
   the official "stop this Session's activity" path; it fans out `workspace/session-stop`, which
   `dsh-agent`, `dsh-jobs`, `dsh-schedule` and `dsh-subagent` all listen to.
2. **Detach the live Session** — `ctx.sessions.store.get(id).detach()`. The store keeps entries in
   a non-public map, and calling the entry's own `detach` is the single seam that raises
   `session/disposed`.
3. **Remove the sidebar row** — `session/disposed` → `api-session/removed`
   (`dsh-api-session-controller`) → `ctx.remote.$on("api-session/removed", …)` on the client. That
   chain is the only reason the row disappears without a reload.
   A **cold** Session (one restored from disk that was never opened in this process) has no store
   entry, so `detach` cannot fire. For that case the plugin emits `api-session/removed` itself —
   the same signal, by the same name. Nothing on the Host listens for that event, so this is
   side-effect free.
4. **Forget the membership** — `detachSession` on every Workspace, plus `unarchiveSession` and
   `unpinSession`, so no archived or pinned ghost survives.
5. **Remove the bytes** — the artifact directory under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<id>/`
   and the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`.

The SQLite session index is *derived* from persistence state, so it converges on its own during the
next reconcile — the plugin does not touch it.

### Files touched on disk

Everything the plugin removes lives under `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`):

```
$DSH_HOME/
  sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   <- removed
  storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json         <- removed
  storages/workspace.json                                       <- membership updated in place
```

## Install

The plugin installs as a **profile bundle**, using DSH's own plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

From a local checkout instead of a git host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-session-delete
```

Use the profile you actually launch DSH with (`web` is the DSH Desktop default, and is also what
`dsh plugin …` assumes when you omit `--profile`). `dsh` is a shim into the packaged CLI, placed on
`PATH` once DSH Desktop has been started at least once.

> [!NOTE]
> **The repository must be public for the `github:` shorthand.** pnpm probes the HTTPS URL first and
> only falls back to SSH when that probe fails, which is what happens for a private repository or a
> nonexistent one. On a machine where outbound SSH (port 22) is blocked, that fallback fails with
> `ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Connection refused`. For a private repository, use an
> explicit HTTPS spec and let git's credential helper authenticate:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git
> ```

Then reload the DSH page in your browser so it picks up the browser bundle, and open a Session's
`...` menu in the sidebar. **DSH itself does not need restarting.**

To update after new commits land, re-run the same command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

Re-running `add` *is* the update path: pnpm re-resolves the ref, and a changed shipped file lands in
a new content-addressed store directory, so DSH imports a **new module URL** and the Host half
genuinely reloads. See [Host reload semantics](#host-reload-semantics).

To remove it again:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-delete
```

That prunes the dependency, drops the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, and unloads both halves —
verified live: the route stops answering and the browser bundle leaves the client-module graph.

> [!NOTE]
> For a **local-path** install the profile entry is a `link:`, and pnpm was observed to leave the
> symlink at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` behind after a `remove`.
> It is inert, but delete it by hand if you want the tree clean. Git installs are unaffected.

### What `dsh plugin add` actually does

`dsh plugin` is a thin front end for pnpm: it forwards its arguments to pnpm **inside the profile
directory** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/`). The part that makes the plugin load is what DSH does
next — it reconciles the profile manifest and, for every dependency that was just added and declares
a `dsh.bundle.patch`, appends its package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json, after the add
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-delete": "git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "…existing bundles…",
        "dsh-session-delete"        // <- appended by the add
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` is the **only** thing that decides what loads. That array is why one command
is sufficient and no `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

A dependency that declares no `dsh.bundle` is installed as a plain dependency and skipped, with a
warning:

```
dsh: warning: <name> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

The bundled [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) is the patch this profile layer reads:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: 'dsh-session-delete'
```

`name` is the **package name**, not a path — the profile resolves it from its own `node_modules`.

> [!NOTE]
> `client.js` registers itself under the name `dsh-session-delete`, which must stay
> **character-for-character identical** to `name` in `package.json`. client-modules derives the
> browser bundle's id from the enclosing `package.json` and rejects a bundle that registers under
> anything else — and the only symptom is a menu row that silently never appears.

## Host reload semantics

Node's ESM registry caches modules by **resolved URL** and offers no invalidation hook. That has one
practical consequence:

> **Editing an installed `host.js` in place does not take effect in a running DSH.**

How much that bites depends on how you installed:

- **From git**, pnpm copies the package into its content-addressed store. A changed file produces a
  new store dire

plugins.description: Profile-level skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: a flat skill inventory with enable/disable, discovery diagnostics and a restorable trash, in a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mgr

**Every skill in one list** — the whole profile inventory in a sidebar panel: see what is installed, read a skill's body, enable or disable it, repair a discovery problem, and delete it into a trash you can restore from.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a hunt through `~/.dsh/skills`, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

A skill is a folder with a discovery file in it, which is easy to create and hard to keep track of: which ones exist, which are currently switched off (a renamed file is invisible, not absent), which one has a broken frontmatter, and which are duplicates across the two writable roots. This plugin is the one place that answers those questions, without an editor open and without hand-renaming files.

**Enabled is the default, and disabling is a filesystem fact first.** The discovery file is renamed (`SKILL.md` → `SKILL.md.disabled`, or `<name>.md` → `<name>.md.disabled`) so the filesystem provider simply stops seeing it; a registry record is what lets the panel still list it and switch it back on.

## Screenshots

![The Skills panel: the flat profile inventory](docs/images/skills-panel.png)

*Skills — one flat table over the profile inventory (enabled and disabled alike), with search, a source filter, use-count and last-used chips, the discovery diagnostics and the restorable trash.*

![The detail view of one skill](docs/images/skill-detail.png)

*Inspect — the skill's body and metadata, with the enable/disable action for a disabled skill.*

## The registry file

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshsk/skills.json      the profile's skill management state
```

One registry holds everything the manager persists: the disabled-skill records, the trash, and the statistics checkpoint. It is reconciled at startup — a `.disabled` file with no record is adopted (an upgraded or hand-edited install), and a record whose file is gone is dropped. Writes go through an atomic same-directory temp file (`wx`, mode `0600`, then `rename`), and a read that hits unparsable JSON refuses to overwrite it and reports why.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **Skills** page in the centre column |
| Skills table | one flat table of the profile inventory — Name / Source / Description / Status / Actions — with search, sorting and a source filter |
| Enable / disable | renames the discovery file and keeps the record, so the row stays visible (dimmed) and can be switched back on |
| Inspect | reads a skill's body and metadata without leaving the GUI |
| Add skill | scaffolds a new skill in a writable root |
| Discovery diagnostics | lists the skills the provider cannot see, and auto-fixes the repairable ones in place |
| Restorable trash | `Delete` moves a skill into the root's `.trash`; the panel lists it with a Restore action, and clearing the trash is explicit |
| Chat `/` menu dots | marks each candidate row as model-invocable or user-invocable, coloured from the same settings the panel reads |
| Settings card | the plugin's own configuration, in the Plugins manager |
| Attribution | the title chip carries the installed version and the author credit |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the manifest pins it)

## Installation

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → tests → verifiers
pnpm pack                         # dist/dsh-skill-mgr-<version>.tgz
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

The package is not on npm: the profile installs it from this repository. `dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses, and the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

Upgrading from `dsh-skill-hub`? The two packages must not both be installed — they would both claim the plugin-config card. Remove the old bundle first; the new plugin adopts the old state file on its first load and leaves it untouched.

## Quick start

1. Open **Skills** in the sidebar. The table lists every skill in `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills`.
2. Search for a skill; select **Inspect** to read it, or **Disable** to switch it off for the whole profile.
3. Select **Add skill** to scaffold a new one in a writable root.
4. Read the diagnostics banner when something is not being discovered, and use its fix action on the repairable entries.

## Configuration

The Loader entry's config is the settings card; the host reads the same values through their volatile refs.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | contribute the skill provider and the announcement; the management panel keeps working either way, because it is the surface that turns the plugin back on |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | register the system-prompt section that tells an agent this manager exists |
| `showUseCount` | `true` | per-skill invocation-count chip |
| `showUseTime` | `true` | per-skill last-used relative time |
| `dotModelColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "model-invocable" dot, in the table and the chat `/` menu |
| `dotUserColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "user-invocable only" dot |
| `statsWindowDays` | `14` | rolling window for the counts; `0` = all history |
| `statsScanMinutes` | `5` | background session-log scan interval, in minutes |

## Remote surface

The browser half reads and writes through one Typert Remote namespace, `skillMgr`. Two conventions cover the whole surface: `snapshot()` is the one read (the panel loads all of its slices from a single call, cached for one render pass), and every write answers `SkillApplyResult` (`{ok:true}` / `{ok:false, error}`) after which the caller refetches.

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Core | `snapshot` |
| Profile inventory | `saveGlobalSkill`, `removeGlobalSkill`, `setGlobalSkillEnabled`, `skillDetail`, `fixDiagnostic`, `skillStats` |
| Trash | `restoreTrashedSkill`, `clearTrash` |

Nine methods in total. Their parameter and result types live in `src/wire.ts` as zod schemas, and each type is `z.infer` of its schema, so the host implementation, the descriptors and the browser half cannot drift apart.

## Caveats

- **Enable/disable is profile-wide, not per workspace.** Because toggling renames one discovery file, there is no way to have a skill on in one workspace and off in another; every workspace is offered every skill in the profile inventory. A reader who needs per-workspace on/off cannot have it here.
- **Project skills are discovered, not managed.** The provider lists a workspace's own roots so an agent still sees the skills beside it, but they are never part of the profile inventory the panel manages: they cannot be toggled, deleted or adopted. Onl

plugins.description: DSH 会话思考档位插件（think-level）：每个会话六档推理开关（关闭/低/中/高/最高/超高），子代理继承，就近收敛到模型支持档位
plugins.readme_text:
**每个会话页面单独设定推理档位（关闭 / 低 / 中 / 高 / 最高 / 超高），子代理继承所属会话档位。** [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-65a30d?style=flat)](LICENSE) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-0ea5e9?style=flat)](#-兼容性) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-0ea5e9?style=flat)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ![language](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-JS%20plain-F0DB4F?style=flat&logo=javascript&logoColor=000) **中文** · [English](README.en.md)
--- ## ✨ 功能 - **每会话独立**：会话输入区「思考 ▾」六档圆弧选择器，写入本会话档位，会话之间互不影响 - **子代理继承**：沿 `session.header.parentSession` 归属链，找到最近单独设定的会话档位 - **就近收敛**：按目标模型 `reasoningEfforts` **实际支持**的档位自动收敛（如四档模型上 中→高、最高→超高），绝不直发模型不认识的档位 - **模型选择器清理**：隐藏 DSH 原生「推理等级 >」入口与其二级面板（能力词典保留给请求链，界面不再露出） - **双入口同写**：UI 选择器与 `set_thinking_level` 工具走同一写通道，实时生效、持久化到 profile 补丁层 ## 📦 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:373831615/dsh-think-level ``` 本地目录安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本目录绝对路径>`。 ## 🧩 兼容性 | 项 | 支持 | |---|---| | **DSH 内核** | **0.2.x** —— 实测 `0.2.1-alpha.1`（开发期同时覆盖 `0.2.0-rc.2`） | | 界面 | DSH Web（client 半 `platform: web`） | | Node.js | ≥ 20.18.1（安装期） | - 依赖声明：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`（可选 peer，内核自带）`^0.2.0-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-0`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery@^3.18.1` - 内核 API 基线（均为 **0.2.x 世代**）：`agent/request` 瀑布、volatile Config、settings 表单写通道、`conversation.input.left` 插槽、`remote.session` 命名空间 - **0.1.x 未测不承诺**；0.3.x 未出、届时回归再认证 ## 🧭 使用 六档从低到高（内部档位 id）： | 思考 ▾ | 关闭 | 低 | 中 | 高 | 最高 | 超高 | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | 档位 | `off` | `low` | `medium` | `high` | `xhigh` | `max` | - **会话输入区**（模型选择器同排左侧）：点「思考 ▾」为**本会话**选档；未设定的会话显示并跟随默认档 - **对助手说**：「把本会话思考调到超高」→ 工具 `set_thinking_level`（`action=get|set`、`target=session|default`） - **默认档**（未单独设定的会话生效）：`set_thinking_level target=default`，或补丁层 `think-level.config.level` ## ⚙️ 生效机制 ``` 「思考 ▾」/ set_thinking_level │ （同一写通道：configForms → remote.settings → volatile） ▼ Config: level（默认档）+ sessions{会话id: 档位} │ ▼ agent/request 瀑布（prepend，最外层=最终值） 有效档位 = sessions[本会话] ?? 沿父链继承 ?? level │ 就近收敛到 reasoning.efforts ▼ 每次模型调用的 reasoningEffort （子代理继承所属会话档位） ``` - 标题生成、压缩摘要等内部调用不走该瀑布（保持便宜） - 模型配置里的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明是**档位词典**（模型认哪几档的元数据），留给请求链使用；删掉会让六档开关失效 ## 🗂 目录结构 ``` think-level/ ├── main.js # Host：Config（level + sessions）+ agent/request 改写 + set_thinking_level 工具 ├── client.js # Client：会话输入区「思考 ▾」+ 模型选择器推理等级隐藏 ├── cordis.patch.yml # Loader 行（id=think-level，即设置命名空间） ├── locale/ # 显示元数据（en / zh） ├── docs/banner.svg # 横幅 ├── icon.svg # 图标 └── package.json ``` ## 🧪 开发备注 - **Client 半（client.js）存盘即生效**（client-hmr 轮询 + SSE 热替换，或刷新页面） - **Host 半（main.js）改码受模块代际缓存约束**：同身份热替换在运行中进程里不生效，可靠做法是换包名/目录/行 id 全新身份重装，或重启内核 - 工具契约坑：`output.render(args, value)` 首参是工具入参；schemastery `z.dict(inner, sKey)` 第一参是**值** schema - 隐藏推理等级入口的刀口：remote 命名空间方法是 getter-only 访问器，包装要打底层 `invokeRemote` ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Agent profiles for DSH: per-session persona, duties, avatar and long-term memory, injected as a system-prompt section.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-profiles —— 智能体配置

> **English summary** — Multiple AI agent profiles for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): role, avatar, personality, speaking style, ground rules and long-term memory — one global default, plus a per-conversation override with its own instructions and memory.
> **Install:** `dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles` (recommended, from npm). The tarball and from-source alternatives are in the 安装 / Install section below. Then restart DSH for the host half and reload the page for the client half.
> **Highlights:** choose the active profile, pin a profile per conversation, memory-injection toggle, import / export, restore defaults.
> **Language:** the settings UI follows the host language setting — Chinese and English dictionaries are both built in. **Model-facing prompts stay in Chinese** by design.
> **License:** MIT.

多套 AI 智能体配置：**角色设定 / 性格特点 / 说话习惯 / 行为准则 / 长期记忆摘要 / 记忆条目**。

两层作用范围：

| 层           | 在哪改            | 作用范围                                  |
| ----------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **全局当前配置**  | 设置 →「智能体配置」    | 没做专属设定的对话都用它                          |
| **每个对话的配置** | 输入框左侧下拉 + ⚙ 面板 | 只影响这一个对话；可固定某套配置，还能写**本对话专属**的补充设定与记忆 |

无论哪一层，切换都是**立即生效且只影响之后的对话**，历史记录一个字都不动。

## 安装 / Install

**✅ 推荐 / Recommended —— 从 npm 安装（用包名，不要手抄 tarball 地址）：**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-agent-profiles
```

*装完按提示重启 DSH；客户端那一半刷新页面即可生效。*
*Restart DSH when prompted; reload the page for the client half.*

### 备选方式 / Alternatives

**① tarball —— 直接装打包文件 / install the packed tarball**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-agent-profiles/-/dsh-agent-profiles-0.7.0.tgz
```

**② 源码 —— clone 后把本地目录链接进 profile / from source: clone and link the folder**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MoYu-CN/dsh-agent-profiles.git
dsh plugin add "link:<你的目录>/dsh-agent-profiles"
```

`link:` 不拷贝、直接软链，改代码立刻生效 —— 适合要改插件本身的场景。
`link:` symlinks instead of copying, so local edits take effect immediately — use it when you want to modify the plugin itself.

## 界面

### 设置 →「智能体配置」

![设置页](docs/settings-page.png)

*设置页：左栏配置列表（新建 / 复制 / 导入 / 导出），右栏编辑名称、头像与角色设定。*
*The settings page: the profile list on the left, and the name / avatar / role fields on the right.*

### 输入框左侧的快速切换器

![快速切换器](docs/quick-switcher.png)

*快速切换器：给**这个对话**挑一套配置 ——「跟随全局」表示用设置页里当前那一套。*
*The quick switcher: pick a profile for **this conversation**; "follow global" means the active profile from the settings page.*

### 回合头的头像与名称

![回合头](docs/message-header.png)

*回合头：本插件在官方「已完成 …」那一行**上方**加一行「[头像] 配置名」，官方那一行原样保留。*
*The turn head: this plugin adds an "[avatar] profile name" line **above** the stock "completed …" row, leaving that row untouched.*

### 长期记忆条目

![长期记忆](docs/memory-settings.png)

*长期记忆：逐条编辑**长期记忆条目**（每条自带「编辑 / 删除」），下方实时显示「长期记忆占用 746 / 5000 字；超过上限会自动提炼压缩」。*
*Long-term memory: edit the **long-term memory entries** one by one (each with its own edit / delete), with a live "long-term memory uses 746 / 5000 characters; past the cap it is condensed automatically" readout below.*

> 截图为**中文界面**下的实测界面（设置 UI 跟随宿主语言，内置中英两套词典）。
> The screenshots show the UI in Chinese (the settings UI follows the host language; both dictionaries ship built in).

---

## 1. 整体结构与模块划分

```
dsh-agent-profiles/
├── package.json          ── ① 包清单：bundle patch + dsh.client 声明 + meta/icon
├── cordis.patch.yml      ── ① 装配：插入 agent-profiles 行，硬依赖 webServer
├── icon.svg              ── ① 插件卡片图标
├── locale/zh.json,en.json── ② 元数据文案（宿主读插件卡片用）
└── lib/
    ├── store.js          ── ③ 数据模型 + 持久化 + 导入导出 + 变更算子
    ├── prompt.js         ── ④ 配置 → 注入文本（记忆开关、优先级声明、截断）
    ├── routes.js         ── ⑤ Host HTTP API（/__ap/*）+ index.html 脚本注入
    ├── index.js          ── ⑥ Host 入口：装配 store/prompt/routes + 注册提示词段落
    └── client.js         ── ⑦ 浏览器半：设置页（分栏）+ 输入框快速切换器
```

### 数据流

```
                       ┌──────────────── Host 进程 ────────────────┐
  设置页 / 快速切换器   │                                            │
   （浏览器）           │   routes.js  /__ap/state   /__ap/command   │
        │  fetch        │      │            /__ap/preview  /__ap/export
        └──────────────►│      ▼                                     │
                        │   store.js ──► profiles.json（原子写）      │
                        │      │                                     │
                        │      │  每次组装提示词时现算                │
                        │      ▼                                     │
                        │   prompt.js ──► systemPrompt.section(      │
                        │                   text: () => renderActive)│
                        └────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                         │
                                         ▼
                              模型看到的本轮系统提示词
```

### 为什么这么切

| 模块          | 单独成层的理由                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `store.js`  | 「配置长什么样、存哪、坏了怎么办」的生命周期是**磁盘**；与「怎么渲染成提示词」「怎么传给界面」完全不同步 |
| `prompt.js` | 这是**产品文案**层：段落顺序、空字段省略、记忆开关、截断说明都会随反馈反复改；改它不该碰到数据与传输代码 |
| `routes.js` | 传输与鉴权（同源守卫、体积上限、方法限制）是一组独立关注点，与业务算子分开才好测               |
| `index.js`  | 只做装配与降级（缺服务时怎么办），本身不含业务规则                              |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半必须自包含：不能 require 任何 Harness Client 包（见下）           |

---

## 2. 关键设计决策

### ① 提示词段落交的是「函数」，不是「字符串」

```js
systemPrompt.section({
  name: "agent-profiles:persona",
  order: 860,
  text: () => renderActive(store),   // ← 每次组装现算
});
```

字符串在注册那一刻就定死了，之后切换配置不会生效（重复注册同名段落会抛错）。  
交函数则**每次组装读一次当前的 activeId**，于是：

- 切换配置 ⇒ 下一次组装就是新配置 ⇒ **立即生效**；
- 历史消息存在会话日志里，本插件从不写它 ⇒ **历史不受影响**。

这两条不是顺手做到的，是把渲染做成函数直接换来的性质。

### ② `systemPrompt` 不进 `inject`，走 `ctx.get()` 软探测

硬依赖的语义是「缺了就整个插件停在 pending」。缺 `systemPrompt` 会让**设置界面也不出现**，  
用户连「为什么没有界面」都无从判断。所以：注入是增强，界面是本体，本体不该被增强拖死。  
（`webServer` 是硬依赖 —— 没它连界面都发不出去。）

### ③ 「每个对话一套」靠 **agent 作用域的同名段落**，不靠全局开关

全局段落只知道全局配置 —— 它拿不到「现在在跟哪个对话说话」。所以每个对话要有一个  
挂在该 agent 自己 ctx 上的段落：

```js
ctx.on("agent/created", ({ agent }) => {          // agent.id 就是 sessionId
  agentCtx.effect(() => systemPrompt.section({
    name: "agent-profiles:persona",                // ← 与全局段落**同名**
    order: 860,
    text: () => renderForSession(store, sessionId),
  }));
});
```

官方规则是「作用域段落压过同名全局段落」，于是：

- 有 agent 作用域段落 ⇒ 用**这个对话**的绑定与专属设定；
- 没有（非 agent 组装、或 `agent.ctx` 拿不到）⇒ 回落到全局段落的全局配置。

`agent/created` 是 **await 的**（早于第一步组装），所以注册一定赶在第一次注入之前完成；  
拿不到 `agent.ctx` 时**只降级 + 记一条 warning，绝不抛错** ——  
那个事件抛错会让 **agent 创建失败**，比「本对话设定没生效」严重得多。

两层各自的组装次数都会记进诊断（`本对话段 SN 次 / 全局兜底段 GN 次`），  
设置页能直接看到 —— 「每个对话独立注入」不是靠信念，是靠这个计数。

### ④ 出厂默认就带着一套准则

默认启用的「通用助手」是**填好内容**的（用户明确要求）：实事求是、简洁直白、不猜想臆想、  
服从现行的 AI 内容规范与平台审核要求、做没做好都如实说。出厂即生效 —— 新会话里默认助手  
就按这套说话，不用先手动配置。

> 早期版本这里是**刻意留空**的，理由是「装一个插件不该悄悄改变用户助手的行为」。  
> 用户看过实际效果后明确要求给默认助手写准则，于是**有意填上**。  
> 想回到零注入：把这一套的四个内容字段清空即可，`hasContent()` 会自动让它不进提示词  
> （注入与技能目录都会跳过它）。  
> 测试里把「默认准则必须含这五条」钉成了断言 —— 谁清空，谁就要面对红灯。

### ④c 长期记忆的自动化：工具 + 每 5 回合后台提炼 + 超限压缩

用户选择的是**两者都要**：模型能主动存，插件再定期兜底。

```
① 工具 memory_save      模型觉得值得长期记住 → 当场写进「本对话生效的那套配置」
② 后台提炼（每 5 回合）  插件读对话 → 调一次模型 → 把要点存进去
③ 超限压缩             长期记忆 > 5000 字 → 调模型合并成「摘要 + 精简条目」
```

**触发点**是 `agent/status` 变成 `idle`（一个回合跑完）——  
不能挂 `running`，那是回合**开始**，内容还没产生。

**写入目标**按会话 id **当场解析**（会话绑定优先，否则全局当前），  
绝不缓存「当前配置 id」：用户在对话中途切换配置时，缓存会把记忆写错地方。

**为什么压缩必须由插件做、不能交给模型自觉**：模型不知道「记忆满了」。  
预算判断只能由持有数据的一方做。

**四条硬约束（每条都对应一种「把会话弄坏」的形态，都有测试）**：

1. **绝不抛错到调用方**。后台跑的代码，任何异常都不该影响用户正在进行的对话；  
   所有对外调用包 try/catch，失败只记日志。
2. **绝不并发**。同一会话同一时刻只跑一次；否则两次跑起来会重复写同一批记忆。
3. **输入必须有上限**。送进模型的对话摘录截断到 6000 字 —— 那是用户的钱。
4. **输出必须能解析**。要求模型「一行一条」，**不用 JSON**：JSON 一旦格式跑偏整批丢失，  
   行文本最坏只是存进一条废话。压缩结果为空时**保持原样**，绝不冒险覆盖。

**缺服务要在装载时就说清楚**（缺 `sessionQuery` / `llm` / `tools` 各一条告警）：  
静默跳过的现象是「功能好像没生效」，用户分不清是没触发还是没能力。

**顺带修掉的一个真 bug**：`ProfileStore.command()` 原来只回传 `notice`，  
把算子自己的附加字段（`memory.autoAdd` 的 `added`）丢了 ——  
现象是「记忆明明存进去了，日志和诊断里却什么都没有」。现在附加字段原样带出。

### ④b 空配置不注入、且记忆关闭时整块消失

只起了个名字的配置不产生注入（`hasContent()`）。  
关闭记忆注入时是**整块不出现**，而不是出现「（记忆已关闭）」——后者仍占上下文，  
还会暗示模型「有记忆但你看不到」，让它开始猜记忆内容，比不注入更糟。

### ⑤ 客户端不 require 任何 Harness Client 包

官方 `practices.md` 明令禁止：那些包随版本变化、plain-JS 无类型检查，  
一个抛错的组件会**清空整个插槽条目**。所以控件全部自己写，样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` token

plugins.description: Sage mode（贤者模式）: a read-only advisory session mode for DeepSeek Harness — answer, advise, review, teach, brainstorm, and diagnose with read/search/web tools only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sage-mode · Sage Mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **read-only advisory mode** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) sessions.
Enter with `/sage`, leave with `/sage off`.

While the mode is active, the session keeps only read/search/web tools. Every tool that
edits, deletes, or executes is **hidden from the model** and **denied at execution**.
At the same time an advisory system-prompt section turns the model into your thinking
partner: it answers, advises, evaluates, explains, brainstorms, and diagnoses — instead of
changing your workspace.

The name comes from **Sage (贤者)**: the wise one gives counsel, not a hand.

## Why

Coding agents are built to act. Sometimes you do not want action — you want to understand
code, compare approaches, learn a concept, brainstorm, or debug an error. Sage mode gives
that intent a first-class switch: the agent can still read your repository and search the
web, but it cannot touch anything.

## Usage

| Input | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/sage` | Enter Sage mode: read-only tools only, advisory prompt injected |
| `/sage <question>` | Enter the mode **and** send that question as your next message (images/files allowed) |
| `/sage off` | Leave; the full toolset is restored immediately |

Typical uses: understanding an unfamiliar implementation, learning a codebase, comparing
design options, brainstorming, pasting a stack trace. When you are ready to actually change
code, run `/sage off`.

Entering the mode changes what the model can call, not the sandbox: hidden tools are removed
from the request's tool catalog entirely, and anything that still reaches dispatch is refused
by a `tools.guard()` that returns "let the user run `/sage off` first".

## Tools kept (default)

`read` `read_image` `glob` `grep` `web_search` `web_fetch` `ask_user_question` `skill`
`cordis_inspect_list` `cordis_inspect_query` `load_workspace_dependencies`

Everything else is hidden — `write` `edit` `ops_replace`, `pwsh`/`bash` and background jobs,
`subagent`/`send_message`, `plugin_manager`, `todo_write`, `present`, goal and team-task
tools, and so on. Names that do not exist in your composition are ignored, so one list works
across agent presets.

## Reference

### Optional dependency: dsh-ops

The fast read-only tools — `ops_glob`, `ops_grep`, `ops_inspect_local_file` — come from
**[dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops)**, a separate bundle. Sage mode declares them
as an **optional dependency** (`optionalTools` in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)):

- **dsh-ops installed** → those tools are adopted into the allow list and stay available.
- **dsh-ops absent** → the names are ignored and everything else keeps working. A missing
  optional provider is never an error.


To adopt a read-only tool from any other bundle, extend the map without touching the code:

```yaml
config:
  optionalTools:
    some-other-plugin: [their_read_tool]
```

### Also see

- [dsh-ops](https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops) — the optional source of the `ops_*` tools.
- [Sage mode repository](https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode) — this plugin.

## Install

Open **Plugin Manager** in the Harness and enter this repository's URL as the install spec:

```
https://github.com/zero360-TYN/dsh-sage-mode
```
![pic_location: /readme_pic/install.png](/readme_pic/install.png)
The manager reads a GitHub repository URL as a git install spec, clones the package, adds its
`sage-mode` row, and activates it. Updating later means installing the same URL again; a fresh
JavaScript module generation needs an app restart to load.

<details>
<summary>Alternative: install from a local directory</summary>

From a checkout, point the manager at the absolute path instead:

```
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this repo>")
```

That installs the package as a **link**, so editing files in the repo affects the live plugin
directly — convenient while developing.

</details>

## Configuration

The row's defaults live in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). Your own overrides belong
in the profile's user layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`). A patch replaces
the targeted row's **whole** `config`, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: sage-mode
  name: dsh-sage-mode
  config:
    command: sage          # command name (default: sage)
    sectionOrder: 3255     # prompt section placement
    allowedTools: [read, grep, web_search]   # keep only these
    optionalTools:         # optional deps: adopt their read-only tools when present
      dsh-ops: [ops_glob, ops_grep, ops_inspect_local_file]
    section: |             # the full advisory prompt
      ...
```

Unknown keys fail at load instead of being ignored, so a typo cannot silently disable your
configuration. Missing keys fall back to their defaults.

## How it works

- **State lives in the session log.** The mode folds the `command/run` + `command/done`
  pair the commands service already writes, so it adds **no custom event type** — an
  unknown event type would make older readers refuse to reopen the session. Resume and fork
  restore the mode automatically.
- **Enforced per agent.** `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })` hides the mutating tools and
  `agent.ctx.tools.guard()` denies anything that still reaches dispatch. Both disposers are
  owned by `agent.ctx` *and* kept in the plugin's own effect, so agent disposal and plugin
  unload both unwind them.
- **Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies.** A profile-installed bundle resolves those only from
  the dsh installation, so the plugin uses Node builtins plus services reached through `ctx`.
- The prompt section is registered on the agent's own scope and returns an empty string while
  the mode is off — no token cost when unused.

## Known limits

- Applies to the **current session only**; other tabs and sessions are unaffected.
- Under PTC mode the `run_code` transport itself is kept (otherwise the whole tool surface
  becomes unusable), but the generated SDK exposes only the permitted read-only tools.
- Plan mode's `exit_plan_mode` is hidden too; leave plan mode with `/plan off` or `/sage off`.
- Sandbox and approval policy are unaffected — this plugin governs **which tools the model
  holds**, not filesystem permissions.

## Test

```powershell
node test/self-test.mjs
```

Covers config validation, the session-log fold, the command contract, restriction/guard
registration and release, the fallback mask for unusual compositions, and admitting agents
that already existed when the plugin loaded.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for effort & token insights by date and workspace.DSH 工作量报告插件：按日期与工作区看清「我的付出」与 Token 消耗，含日历热力图 / 时刻分析 / 工作区占比，可导出自包含 HTML 报告。
plugins.readme_text:
# TimeMirror for DSH · Workload Report

> Put **your effort** and **your token spend** on the same picture: see where your time went and where the tokens went, by **date** and by **workspace** — calendar heatmap, time-of-day analysis, workspace share, and a **one-click self-contained HTML report you can send straight to a client**.
> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for effort & token insights.

> **TimeMirror** is a macOS time-distribution app I published on the Mac App Store; this plugin brings the same idea to AI-assisted work — **the time you and your AI spend, and what it costs, made visible**.
> The package/repo uses the descriptive name `dsh-workload-report` so it can be found in the DSH ecosystem; the brand stays TimeMirror.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workload-report)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/actions)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)

[中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · English

## What problem it solves

You use AI every day, but you **cannot say where the work went or what it was worth**:

- **Self-review**: which project did the last 30 days actually go to? Which hours am I sharpest?
- **Reporting to a client or your team**: not "I've been busy", but "this project took 46.2% of my effort, 3.74 B tokens, and I was on it 18 of the last 30 days."
- **Blog posts / monthly reports**: a calendar heatmap plus time-of-day analysis is made to be screenshotted.

DSH itself only shows a stats line for the **current session**; the cross-session, cross-project, cross-time view is what this plugin adds.

**Not just cost — the work behind it.** Cost meters tell you what you spent; this plugin also tells you *what you did*: how many days you showed up, which hours you were sharpest, and which project your effort actually went into. That is the part you can put in front of a client.

## Features

- ✅ **Effort vs. spend per workspace**: each row shows "My effort" on the left (active time + active days + turns/steps) and "Token spend" on the right (total + output/cache). Both bars use the same scale, so they compare directly.
- ✅ **Calendar heatmap**: rows Mon–Sun, columns Year-Week, colour = active time. It always shows the **full history**, with 7 per-weekday totals glued to the right edge — you can see at a glance which weekday you are busiest.
- ✅ **Time-of-day analysis**: who is active from 0–23, with the peak hour highlighted (definition: each session's active window is spread across the covered hours by wall-clock share).
- ✅ **Workspace donut**: Top 6 + others, switchable between time and tokens.
- ✅ **Shareable HTML report**: a single file with inline CSS and inline SVG, no scripts and no external links; light/dark themes, custom title and note, and `anonymize=1` to hide workspace names and session titles.
- ✅ **Six KPIs**: active time / total tokens (as a full integer you can verify) / active days / conversations / turns·steps / cache-read share.
- ✅ **Official interfaces only**: no log-format parsing, no business data written, no outbound requests. Values come from zero-I/O projection-checkpoint reads, with an official cold-read fallback and a reusable local index.
- ✅ **Theme and locale aware**: every colour comes from host theme tokens (`--dsw-*`), so it follows the harness's light/dark theme and Chinese/English locale.

## Screenshots

**Home**: six KPIs + calendar heatmap (switchable to a bar chart) + side-by-side time-of-day analysis and workspace share + a collapsed daily table

![dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-calendar.png)

**By workspace**: effort on the left, token spend on the right, two bars on one scale

![workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/dashboard-workspace.png)

**The exported report** (single file, safe to send to a client)

![report light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-light.png)

<details>
<summary>Dark-theme report</summary>

![report dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tableau-China/dsh-workload-report/main/assets/report-dark.png)

</details>

## Install

### 1. Straight from GitHub (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tableau-China/dsh-workload-report#main
```

The built client bundle (`lib/client.js`) is committed, so **no local build is needed**. Restart the Web profile afterwards — a "Workload report" entry appears at the bottom of the sidebar.

### 2. Link a local checkout

```bash
cd /path/to/dsh-workload-report
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD     # points the profile at your source tree
```

### 3. From npm

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workload-report
```

> Published on npm: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workload-report>
> If your npm client points at a mirror (e.g. npmmirror), a brand-new package can take a few minutes to appear — use option 1 if you are in a hurry.

Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workload-report`.

## Configuration

Override any of these in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (all optional):

```yaml
- id: workload-report
  name: dsh-workload-report
  config:
    apiPath: /workload-report/v1        # read-only API prefix
    defaultDays: 7                      # default range
    defaultScope: all                   # all | main | subagent
    defaultTitle: Workload Report       # report title
    workspaceAliases:                   # display names (very handy for client-facing reports)
      my-shop-app: Retail Order System
      data-platform: Data Platform
```

## Read-only API

| Route | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `GET {apiPath}/snapshot?days=30&tz=Asia/Shanghai&scope=all` | Aggregated snapshot JSON (totals / byDay / byWorkspace / byHour / bySession / calendar / diagnostics) |
| `GET {apiPath}/export.json?...` | Same payload, sent with `content-disposition` for download |
| `GET {apiPath}/report.html?days=90&theme=dark&anonymize=1&title=...` | Self-contained HTML report |
| `GET {apiPath}/health` | Index diagnostics (session count, checkpoint hits, cold reads, read failures, duration) |

Parameters: `from`/`to` (YYYY-MM-DD, take precedence over `days`), `days`, `all=1` (earliest active day → today), `tz` (IANA time zone), `scope`.

## Metric definitions

The full definitions live in **[docs/metrics.md](./docs/metrics.md)**. Durations are always shown in **`H / M / S`** (language-neutral, like K/M/B for tokens, so one format serves every locale). The three most misunderstood:

- **Active time** = model time + tool time. It is **cumulative engine work**, not wall-clock time; concurrent sessions and subagents each add up.
- **Conversations** = sessions with at least one step. Zero-step sessions (opened but unused) are listed separately.
- **Attribution date** = the session's creation day in the selected time zone; a session resumed across midnight still counts on its creation day.

## Privacy

All statistics stay on your machine. The plugin registers **read-only** HTTP routes only: no outbound requests, no telemetry, no user content collected.
The single file it writes is its own index cache at `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v*.json` — delete it and the plugin rebuilds by cold-reading; nothing else in your harness data is touched.
Whether the exported HTML report contains session titles is your call (`anonymize=1` hides them).

## Development

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm add -D esbuild puppeteer-core` | Install build and E2E dependencies (or point `ESBUILD_PATH` / `WL_PUPPETEER_DIR` at existing installs) |
| `node build.mjs` | Bundle `src/client/` into `lib/client.js` (ModuleLoader factory format) with esbuild |
| `node test/verify.mjs` | 124 offline assertions: aggregation semant
